Each analysis is run on the same public file twice: by **`chromosomix`**, the command-line form of
the app's Analysis panel (the same code), and by the **reference package** it reproduces, called as
its authors intend. The two outputs are matched bin by bin or call by call. Every command is printed
as it ran, from `notebooks/work/validation/`, and written to `commands.json` there, from which
`{python} R.link('timing')` runs each again and times it.

| § | Analysis | Data | Reference |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Diamond insulation | mouse Hi-C, 10 kb | `cooltools.insulation` |
| 2 | Directionality index | mouse Hi-C, 50 kb | `domaincaller` |
| 3 | Compartments | mouse Hi-C, 100 kb | `cooltools.eigs_cis` |
| 4 | P(s) | yeast Micro-C, 800 bp; mouse Hi-C, 10 kb | `cooltools.expected_cis` |
| 5 | Peak calling | mouse ATAC-seq, two replicates, chr19 | yapc 0.1 with IDR 2.0.3 |
| 6 | Loops | yeast Micro-C, 800 bp | chromosight 1.6.3 |
| 7 | Reproducibility | chicken Hi-C, three maps, 100 kb | hicrep 0.2.6 |
| 8 | 3D model | yeast Micro-C, 12.8 kb | pastis (GitHub `6888ac2`) |
| 9 | Coverage | mouse Hi-C, 10 kb | `cooltools.coverage` |
| 10 | Virtual 4C | mouse Hi-C, 10 kb | `cooltools.virtual4c` |
| 11 | Aggregate peak analysis | mouse Hi-C, 10 kb | coolpuppy |
| 12 | APA, chromosight's score | mouse Hi-C, 10 kb | `chromosight quantify` |
| 13 | Boost-HiC | mouse Hi-C, 100 kb | Boost-HiC (GitHub `a615aff`) |
| 14 | Metaplot | mouse ATAC-seq, one and two replicates, RefSeq TSS | deepTools `computeMatrix`, `plotProfile`, `plotHeatmap` |
| 15 | Interval overlap | ATAC-seq peaks and promoters, chr19 | bedtools `jaccard`, `intersect`, `shuffle` |
| 16 | Base composition | mm10, 10 kb | `bioframe.frac_gc`, Biopython `GC_skew` |
| 17 | Motif search | mm10, chr19 | `seqkit locate` |
| 18 | Track correlation | mouse ATAC-seq, two replicates, and insulation, chr19, 100 bp to 10 kb | pyBigWig and SciPy; deepTools `multiBigwigSummary`, `plotCorrelation` |

**To render.** `npm run build:cli` at the repository root builds this checkout's `chromosomix`.
yapc needs an environment of its own (numpy < 1.24; the recipe is in the yapc section of
`scripts/make_analysis_golden.py`); Boost-HiC is a checkout, beside the repository or named in
`BOOSTHIC_DIR`; bedtools and seqkit are programs on the `PATH` (conda, or the system's packages); the
other references share one environment, with SciPy before 1.18, which dropped an argument pastis
passes:

```bash
python -m venv refs && . refs/bin/activate
pip install jupyter matplotlib cooler cooltools bioframe pyfaidx pyBigWig 'pandas<3' 'scipy<1.18' \
    chromosight==1.6.3 hicrep==0.2.6 domaincaller==0.1.0 coolpuppy deeptools biopython \
    scikit-learn scikit-image h5py \
    'git+https://github.com/hiclib/pastis@6888ac25ded72ce3e559987b8a31b3f8ed2935ed'
git clone https://github.com/LeopoldC/Boost-HiC ../Boost-HiC
QUARTO_PYTHON=refs/bin/python YAPC_PYTHON=yapc-env/bin/python quarto render notebooks/validation.qmd
```

`notebooks/requirements.txt` is that environment at the versions this page was last rendered with,
every package pinned, and `requirements-yapc.txt` yapc's. `.github/workflows/notebooks.yml` installs
both and renders this page and the timings on every release, publishing them at
<https://chromosomix.app/validation/> and <https://chromosomix.app/timings/>; the block under the
title says which render this is.

The data (6 GB) are fetched once into `notebooks/work/validation/data/`. Outputs are kept beside them,
so a second render reads rather than recomputes (`REDO`).

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import os

#: Run a step again even where its outputs are already on disk.
REDO = False
#: Processes for the reference packages that take them.
THREADS = 4
#: yapc 0.1's interpreter, relative to the repository or absolute.
YAPC_PYTHON = os.environ.get('YAPC_PYTHON', 'yapc-env/bin/python')
#: A checkout of LeopoldC/Boost-HiC, relative to the repository or absolute.
BOOSTHIC_DIR = os.environ.get('BOOSTHIC_DIR', '../Boost-HiC')

HERE = Path.cwd().resolve()
REPO = HERE.parent if HERE.name == 'notebooks' else HERE
CLI = REPO / 'dist-cli' / 'chromosomix.mjs'
WORK = REPO / 'notebooks' / 'work' / 'validation'
DATA = WORK / 'data'
SCRIPTS = REPO / 'notebooks' / 'scripts'
#: Every command of this notebook, as timing.qmd runs it again.
MANIFEST = WORK / 'commands.json'
YAPC_PYTHON = Path(YAPC_PYTHON) if Path(YAPC_PYTHON).is_absolute() else REPO / YAPC_PYTHON
BOOSTHIC_DIR = Path(BOOSTHIC_DIR) if Path(BOOSTHIC_DIR).is_absolute() else (REPO / BOOSTHIC_DIR).resolve()
```

```{python}
import hashlib
import html
import json
import re
import shlex
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import warnings
from importlib.metadata import version

import cooler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pyBigWig
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap, LogNorm
from scipy import stats

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
if not CLI.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f'{CLI} is not there: run `npm run build:cli` at the repository root.')
if not (BOOSTHIC_DIR / 'HiCutils.py').exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f'{BOOSTHIC_DIR} holds no Boost-HiC: clone LeopoldC/Boost-HiC there, or set BOOSTHIC_DIR.')
DATA.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PYTHON = sys.executable


def tool(name):
    """A program on the PATH, or beside this interpreter where pip put it."""
    return shutil.which(name) or str(Path(PYTHON).parent / name)


CHROMOSIGHT, COMPUTEMATRIX, PLOTPROFILE = tool('chromosight'), tool('computeMatrix'), tool('plotProfile')
PLOTHEATMAP = tool('plotHeatmap')
MULTIBIGWIGSUMMARY, PLOTCORRELATION = tool('multiBigwigSummary'), tool('plotCorrelation')
BEDTOOLS, SEQKIT = tool('bedtools'), tool('seqkit')
#: What a reference's command runs with besides this process's environment.
YAPC_ENV = {'PATH': f'{YAPC_PYTHON.parent}{os.pathsep}{os.environ["PATH"]}'}
BOOSTHIC_ENV = {'BOOSTHIC_DIR': str(BOOSTHIC_DIR)}


def fetch(url, name=None, md5=None):
    """A public file, fetched once into work/validation/data, and held to `md5` where there is one: a
    file of that name from anywhere else is refused rather than compared."""
    path = DATA / (name or urllib.parse.unquote(url.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]))
    if not path.exists():
        print('fetching', url)
        part = path.with_name(path.name + '.part')
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as response, open(part, 'wb') as out:
            shutil.copyfileobj(response, out, 1 << 22)
        part.rename(path)
    if md5 is not None:
        digest = hashlib.md5()
        with open(path, 'rb') as handle:
            for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1 << 22), b''):
                digest.update(block)
        if digest.hexdigest() != md5:
            raise ValueError(f'{path} is not {url}: its MD5 is {digest.hexdigest()}, not {md5}. '
                             'Delete it, and it is fetched again.')
    return path


def rel(path):
    """A path as the commands give it: a file of this repository relative to work/validation/, where
    they run; any other as it is."""
    path = Path(path)
    return os.path.relpath(path, WORK) if path.is_relative_to(REPO) else str(path)


def arg(value):
    return rel(value) if isinstance(value, Path) else str(value)


def typed(argv):
    """A command as a reader would type it: each tool by its installed name."""
    names = {PYTHON: 'python', str(YAPC_PYTHON): 'yapc-env/bin/python', CHROMOSIGHT: 'chromosight',
             COMPUTEMATRIX: 'computeMatrix', PLOTPROFILE: 'plotProfile', SEQKIT: 'seqkit',
             MULTIBIGWIGSUMMARY: 'multiBigwigSummary', PLOTCORRELATION: 'plotCorrelation',
             PLOTHEATMAP: 'plotHeatmap'}
    if argv[:2] == ['node', str(CLI)]:
        argv = ['chromosomix', *argv[2:]]
    return shlex.join([names.get(a, a) for a in argv])


#: Every chromosomix command and every reference command, by name: for the summary and the timing.
APP, REFS, NOTES = {}, {}, {}
#: Where a reference writes, in its command; it may be the start of a longer argument.
OUT = '<out>'
#: What each reference last ran, by name: its command and its scripts' content.
STAMPS = WORK / '.stamps'


def mr(task, *args, out, name, analysis, label='', group=None, bench=True):
    """One chromosomix command into `out`, skipped when `out` holds what this same command wrote at
    this same commit of chromosomix — a pileup cached from an older build is the older build's.

    `group` pairs it with the reference commands it is timed against; its label by default."""
    out = Path(out)
    argv = ['node', str(CLI), task, *[arg(a) for a in args]]
    full = argv + ['--out', rel(out)]
    APP[name] = dict(analysis=analysis, tool='chromosomix', label=label, group=label if group is None else group,
                     argv=argv, bench=bench, threads=1, shown=typed(full))
    print('$', typed(full))
    stamp = f'{typed(full)}\n# chromosomix {APP_VERSION}\n'
    held = (out / '.command').read_text() if (out / '.command').exists() else ''
    if REDO or not held.startswith(stamp):
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        start = time.time()
        run = subprocess.run(full, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=WORK)
        if run.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(run.stderr[-4000:])
        notes = [line.strip()[len('note: '):] for line in re.split(r'[\r\n]', run.stderr)
                 if line.strip().startswith('note:')]
        (out / '.notes').write_text('\n'.join(notes))
        (out / '.command').write_text(f'{stamp}# {time.time() - start:.1f} s\n')
    NOTES[name] = (out / '.notes').read_text().splitlines()
    return out


def script(name):
    """A reference's script, in notebooks/scripts/: run, printed and timed."""
    path = SCRIPTS / f'{name}.py'
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'{path} is not there.')
    return path


def environment(extra):
    """This process's environment with a command's own additions, or None for it as it is."""
    return None if extra is None else dict(os.environ, **extra)


def reference(name, analysis, tool_, argv, out, made=None, env=None, label='', group=None, threads=1,
              bench=True):
    """A reference command, run once for the comparison (skipped when its output is on disk).

    `argv` holds OUT where the command writes, so the timing can send it elsewhere; `env` is what it
    needs besides this environment, and `threads` the processes it was given."""
    argv = [a if isinstance(a, str) and OUT in a else arg(a) for a in argv]
    out = Path(out)
    real = [a.replace(OUT, rel(out)) for a in argv]
    REFS[name] = dict(analysis=analysis, tool=tool_, label=label, group=label if group is None else group,
                      argv=argv, out=out, env=env, bench=bench, threads=threads, shown=typed(real),
                      scripts=[a for a in argv if a.endswith('.py')])
    print('$', typed(real))
    # Run again when the command or a script it runs has changed since it ran, which its stamp says;
    # a result from before there were stamps is kept unless one of its scripts is newer than it.
    target, ran = Path(made or out), STAMPS / f'{name}.command'
    scripts = [(WORK / s).resolve() for s in REFS[name]['scripts']]
    stamp = f"{typed(real)}\n# scripts {hashlib.sha256(b''.join(s.read_bytes() for s in scripts)).hexdigest()[:16]}\n"
    if ran.exists():
        stale = ran.read_text() != stamp
    else:
        stale = target.exists() and any(s.stat().st_mtime > target.stat().st_mtime for s in scripts)
    if REDO or stale or not target.exists():
        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        run = subprocess.run(real, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=WORK, env=environment(env))
        if run.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(run.stderr[-4000:])
    STAMPS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ran.write_text(stamp)
    return out


def table(path):
    """A table chromosomix wrote: its '#' lines are provenance, not data."""
    return pd.read_csv(path, sep='\t', comment='#')


def one(folder, pattern):
    """The one file of `folder` matching `pattern`."""
    hits = sorted(Path(folder).glob(pattern))
    if len(hits) != 1:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'{len(hits)} files match {pattern} in {folder}')
    return hits[0]


def cached(path, compute):
    """A result of this notebook's own, computed once and kept: a table as TSV, an array as NPY."""
    path = Path(path)
    if path.exists() and not REDO:
        return pd.read_csv(path, sep='\t') if path.suffix == '.tsv' else np.load(path)
    value = compute()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.suffix == '.tsv':
        value.to_csv(path, sep='\t', index=False)
    else:
        np.save(path, value)
    return value


def show(frame, precision=4, **formats):
    """A table without row numbers: the columns named in `formats` their way, the others to `precision`."""
    return frame.style.hide(axis='index').format(formats or None, precision=precision)


def measures(values):
    """Named numbers as a two-column table."""
    return pd.DataFrame(list(values.items()), columns=['measure', 'value']).style.hide(axis='index')


def pearson(a, b):
    ok = np.isfinite(a) & np.isfinite(b)
    return stats.pearsonr(a[ok], b[ok])[0]


def relative_difference(a, b):
    """|a − b| over the larger of the two, cell by cell."""
    return np.abs(a - b) / np.maximum(np.maximum(np.abs(a), np.abs(b)), 1e-300)


# Blue is chromosomix, orange the reference.
APP_COLOUR, REF = '#2a78d6', '#eb6834'
INK, INK2, GRID, SURFACE, MISSING = '#0b0b0b', '#52514e', '#e7e6e2', '#fcfcfb', '#efeeea'
DENSITY = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
    'density', ['#cde2fb', '#86b6ef', '#3987e5', '#1c5cab', '#0d366b'])
plt.rcParams.update({
    'figure.facecolor': SURFACE, 'axes.facecolor': SURFACE, 'savefig.facecolor': SURFACE,
    'axes.edgecolor': INK2, 'axes.labelcolor': INK, 'xtick.color': INK2, 'ytick.color': INK2,
    'text.color': INK, 'axes.spines.top': False, 'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.grid': True, 'grid.color': GRID, 'grid.linewidth': 0.6, 'axes.axisbelow': True,
    'lines.linewidth': 2, 'font.size': 9, 'axes.titlesize': 10, 'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
    'axes.titlelocation': 'left', 'legend.frameon': False, 'figure.dpi': 110,
})


def identity(ax, lo, hi):
    ax.plot([lo, hi], [lo, hi], color=INK2, lw=1, ls=(0, (4, 3)), zorder=3)


def agreement(ax, x, y, xlabel, ylabel, title, scale='linear'):
    """Every pair of values as a density, against the identity line."""
    ok = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
    if scale == 'log':
        ok &= (x > 0) & (y > 0)
    x, y = x[ok], y[ok]
    ax.hexbin(x, y, gridsize=70, cmap=DENSITY, mincnt=1, bins='log', linewidths=0,
              xscale=scale, yscale=scale)
    identity(ax, min(x.min(), y.min()), max(x.max(), y.max()))
    ax.set(xlabel=xlabel, ylabel=ylabel, title=title)
    ax.text(0.03, 0.97, f'{ok.sum():,} values\nPearson r = {stats.pearsonr(x, y)[0]:.4f}',
            transform=ax.transAxes, va='top', fontsize=8, color=INK2)


def square(ax, matrix, title, cmap=DENSITY, norm=None, label=''):
    """A pileup or a map as an image, its colour scale beside it; the scale is returned."""
    image = ax.imshow(matrix, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, interpolation='nearest')
    ax.set(title=title, xticks=[], yticks=[])
    ax.grid(False)
    return plt.colorbar(image, ax=ax, shrink=0.8, label=label)


TEXT = {}
SUMMARY = []


def commands(lines):
    return '<pre>' + html.escape('\n'.join(lines)) + '</pre>'


def record(task, data, reference_, agreement_, verdict, apps, refs):
    """One row of the summary, with the commands as they ran."""
    SUMMARY.append({'§': len(SUMMARY) + 1, 'Analysis': task, 'Data': data,
                    'chromosomix command': commands([f'$ {APP[name]["shown"]}' for name in apps]),
                    'Reference': reference_,
                    'Reference command': commands([f'$ {REFS[name]["shown"]}' for name in refs]),
                    'Agreement': agreement_, 'Verdict': verdict})
```

## Data and versions

Every file is public, read by its accession and fetched from the URL listed. 4DN files come from the
4DN Data Portal's open-data bucket on AWS; the mm10 sequence, used to phase compartments by GC
content and read for composition and motifs, and the RefSeq genes, for the metaplot's TSS and the
promoters, are UCSC's as distributed by Illumina iGenomes; the yeast Micro-C map is GEO's
GSE151553, fetched from GEO. Two are also held to an MD5, and a file of either name that does not
match is refused rather than compared: the yeast map, and 4DN's insulation score for § 18, to the
MD5 4DN publishes for it.

```{python}
def commit(where):
    run = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=where)
    return run.stdout.strip() or 'unknown'


def yapc_versions():
    probe = 'import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version("yapc"), m.version("idr"), m.version("numpy"))'
    try:
        run = subprocess.run([str(YAPC_PYTHON), '-c', probe], capture_output=True, text=True)
        return run.stdout.split() if run.returncode == 0 else ['?'] * 3
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return ['not found'] * 3


def program_version(argv, pattern=r'v?([\d.]+)'):
    """A program's version, as it prints it."""
    run = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True)
    found = re.search(pattern, run.stdout + run.stderr)
    return found.group(1) if found else '?'


APP_VERSION = f"{json.loads((REPO / 'package.json').read_text())['version']} at {commit(REPO)}"
YAPC, IDR, YAPC_NUMPY = yapc_versions()
VERSIONS = {name: version(name) for name in (
    'cooler', 'cooltools', 'bioframe', 'chromosight', 'hicrep', 'domaincaller', 'pastis', 'coolpuppy',
    'deeptools', 'pyBigWig', 'biopython', 'pyfaidx', 'numpy', 'scipy', 'pandas')}
PROGRAMS = {'bedtools': program_version([BEDTOOLS, '--version']),
            'seqkit': program_version([SEQKIT, 'version']),
            'Boost-HiC (GitHub)': commit(BOOSTHIC_DIR)}
#: Each reference by the name its commands give, with its version: for the summary and the timing.
TOOL_VERSIONS = {'chromosomix': APP_VERSION, 'yapc 0.1': f'{YAPC}, with idr {IDR}',
                 'Boost-HiC': PROGRAMS['Boost-HiC (GitHub)'], 'deepTools': VERSIONS['deeptools'],
                 'bioframe, Biopython': f"{VERSIONS['bioframe']}, {VERSIONS['biopython']}",
                 **VERSIONS, **PROGRAMS}
show(pd.DataFrame([{'package': 'chromosomix', 'version': APP_VERSION},
                   *[{'package': k, 'version': v} for k, v in VERSIONS.items()],
                   *[{'package': k, 'version': v} for k, v in PROGRAMS.items()],
                   {'package': 'yapc (own environment)', 'version': f'{YAPC}, with idr {IDR} and numpy {YAPC_NUMPY}'}]))
```

The RefSeq annotation as transcripts: each one's extent over its exons, on its sequence and strand.
The metaplot reads their TSS, the overlap their promoters, and virtual 4C its viewpoints from them.

```{python}
def refseq_transcripts():
    gtf = pd.read_csv(GENES, sep='\t', header=None, comment='#',
                      names=['chrom', 'source', 'feature', 'start', 'end', 'score', 'strand', 'frame', 'attributes'])
    exons = gtf[gtf['feature'] == 'exon'].copy()
    for key in ('transcript_id', 'gene_name'):
        exons[key] = exons['attributes'].str.extract(rf'{key} "([^"]+)"', expand=False)
    out = (exons.groupby(['transcript_id', 'gene_name', 'chrom', 'strand'])
           .agg(start=('start', 'min'), end=('end', 'max')).reset_index()
           .rename(columns={'transcript_id': 'transcript', 'gene_name': 'gene'}))
    out['start'] -= 1  # GTF is 1-based and closed, BED 0-based and half-open
    out['score'] = 0
    return out.sort_values(['chrom', 'start', 'end', 'transcript'])[
        ['chrom', 'start', 'end', 'transcript', 'score', 'strand', 'gene']]


TRANSCRIPTS = cached(WORK / 'genes' / 'transcripts.tsv', refseq_transcripts)
TSS = np.where(TRANSCRIPTS['strand'] == '+', TRANSCRIPTS['start'], TRANSCRIPTS['end'] - 1)
BED6 = ['chrom', 'start', 'end', 'transcript', 'score', 'strand']
measures({'transcripts': f'{len(TRANSCRIPTS):,}', 'genes': f"{TRANSCRIPTS['gene'].nunique():,}",
          'sequences': f"{TRANSCRIPTS['chrom'].nunique()}"})
```

## 1 · Diamond insulation

cooltools' definition: per bin, the mean of the valid cells of the `window × window` square on its
diagonal pixel, the `ignoreDiags` nearest diagonals left out, over the chromosome's median, in log2;
boundaries at the minima whose prominence reaches the threshold.

| | chromosomix | cooltools |
|---|---|---|
| window | `--window 10` (100 kb) | `window_bp=[100_000]` |
| diagonals left out | `--ignoreDiags 2` (default) | `ignore_diags=2` |
| least valid share of a diamond | `--minValid 0.5` (default) | `min_frac_valid_pixels=0.5` |
| boundary threshold | `--prominence 0.2` (default) | `threshold=0.2` |

```{python}
INS = WORK / 'insulation'
MOUSE_10K = f'{rel(MOUSE)}::/resolutions/10000'
mr('insulation', MOUSE_10K, '--window', 10, out=INS / 'app', name='insulation', analysis='Diamond insulation')
reference('cooltools-insulation', 'Diamond insulation', 'cooltools',
          [PYTHON, script('cooltools_insulation'), MOUSE_10K, OUT, THREADS], out=INS / 'cooltools.tsv', threads=THREADS)

clr10 = cooler.Cooler(f'{MOUSE}::/resolutions/10000')
bins10 = clr10.bins()[:]
ref_ins = pd.read_csv(INS / 'cooltools.tsv', sep='\t')
app_ins = table(one(INS / 'app', '*.insulation-w10.tsv'))
assert (app_ins['bin'].to_numpy() == np.arange(len(bins10))).all()
a_ins = app_ins['value'].to_numpy(float)
b_ins = ref_ins['log2_insulation_score_100000'].to_numpy(float)
both = np.isfinite(a_ins) & np.isfinite(b_ins)
ins_diff = np.abs(a_ins[both] - b_ins[both])

app_b = table(one(INS / 'app', '*.insulation-boundaries.tsv'))
ref_b = ref_ins.loc[ref_ins['is_boundary_100000'].astype(bool), ['chrom', 'start', 'boundary_strength_100000']]
calls = app_b[['chrom', 'start', 'score']].merge(ref_b, on=['chrom', 'start'], how='outer', indicator=True)
same_calls = calls[calls['_merge'] == 'both']
strength_diff = np.abs(same_calls['score'] - same_calls['boundary_strength_100000'])
measures({
    'bins both score': f'{both.sum():,}',
    'bins only one scores': f'{int((np.isfinite(a_ins) != np.isfinite(b_ins)).sum()):,}',
    'score, max |difference|': f'{ins_diff.max():.1e}',
    'boundaries, chromosomix / cooltools': f'{len(app_b):,} / {len(ref_b):,}',
    'boundaries at the same bin': f'{len(same_calls):,}',
    'boundary strength, max |difference|': f'{strength_diff.max():.1e}',
})
```

## 2 · Directionality index

Dixon et al. (2012): `sign(B − A)·(B − A)²/(A + B)`, A and B the contacts upstream and downstream within
the window. Reference: `domaincaller`'s `Chrom.calDI` on the balanced matrix, built as its own script
builds it.

| | chromosomix | domaincaller |
|---|---|---|
| window | `--window 40` (2 Mb) | `calDI(window=2_000_000)` |
| cells | every cell off the diagonal, `--ignoreDiags 0` | the upper triangle off the diagonal |
| coverage | `--minValid 0.5`: no score where either side holds under half its window | a score everywhere |

```{python}
DI = WORK / 'di'
MOUSE_50K = f'{rel(MOUSE)}::/resolutions/50000'
mr('di', MOUSE_50K, '--window', 40, out=DI / 'app', name='di', analysis='Directionality index')
reference('domaincaller-di', 'Directionality index', 'domaincaller',
          [PYTHON, script('domaincaller_di'), MOUSE_50K, OUT], out=DI / 'domaincaller.npy')

a_di = table(one(DI / 'app', '*.di-w40.tsv'))['value'].to_numpy(float)
ok = np.isfinite(a_di) & np.isfinite(b_di)
relative = np.abs(a_di[ok] - b_di[ok]) / np.maximum(np.abs(b_di[ok]), np.median(np.abs(b_di[ok])))
di_only_ref = int((np.isfinite(b_di) & ~np.isfinite(a_di)).sum())
measures({
    'bins both score': f'{ok.sum():,}',
    'bins only domaincaller scores': f'{di_only_ref:,}',
    'bins only chromosomix scores': f'{int((np.isfinite(a_di) & ~np.isfinite(b_di)).sum()):,}',
    'relative difference, max': f'{relative.max():.1e}',
    'same sign': f'{(np.sign(a_di[ok]) == np.sign(b_di[ok])).mean():.2%}',
})
```

## 3 · Compartments

cooltools' preparation in both — observed/expected cis, clipped at its 99.9th percentile, less one —
and three eigenvectors ranked by eigenvalue and signed by GC content, computed once per 100 kb bin
(`bioframe.frac_gc`, mm10) and given to both. cooltools signs by Spearman correlation, the app by
Pearson, and the app leaves the sign unset below |r| = 0.1. chrY, mostly unmappable at 100 kb, is left
out of the comparison.

| | chromosomix | cooltools |
|---|---|---|
| components | `--components 3` | `n_eigs=3` |
| phasing | `--phaseTrack gc.bedGraph` | `phasing_track=gc` |
| diagonals left out; clipping | 2; 99.9th percentile (defaults) | `ignore_diags=2`; `clip_percentile=99.9` |
| eigensolver | Lanczos, a component at a time with deflation, to a residual within 10⁻¹² of each eigenvalue | ARPACK's restarted Lanczos (`scipy.sparse.linalg.eigsh`), largest in size |

```{python}
CMP = WORK / 'compartments'
MOUSE_100K = f'{rel(MOUSE)}::/resolutions/100000'
clr100 = cooler.Cooler(f'{MOUSE}::/resolutions/100000')


def gc_content():
    import bioframe
    genome = bioframe.load_fasta(str(MM10), engine='pyfaidx')
    return bioframe.frac_gc(clr100.bins()[['chrom', 'start', 'end']][:], genome)


gc = cached(CMP / 'gc.tsv', gc_content)
GC_TRACK = CMP / 'gc.bedGraph'
if REDO or not GC_TRACK.exists():
    gc.dropna()[['chrom', 'start', 'end', 'GC']].to_csv(GC_TRACK, sep='\t', header=False, index=False)
mr('compartments', MOUSE_100K, '--components', 3, '--phaseTrack', GC_TRACK, out=CMP / 'app',
   name='compartments', analysis='Compartments')
reference('cooltools-eigs', 'Compartments', 'cooltools',
          [PYTHON, script('cooltools_eigs_cis'), MOUSE_100K, CMP / 'gc.tsv', OUT],
          out=CMP / 'cooltools', made=CMP / 'cooltools-eigenvectors.tsv')

ref_vec = pd.read_csv(CMP / 'cooltools-eigenvectors.tsv', sep='\t')
ref_val = pd.read_csv(CMP / 'cooltools-eigenvalues.tsv', sep='\t')
app_vec = {k: table(one(CMP / 'app', f'*.compartment-e{k}.tsv'))['value'].to_numpy(float) for k in (1, 2, 3)}
app_comp = table(one(CMP / 'app', '*.compartment-components.tsv'))


def first(values):
    return values.iloc[0] if len(values) else np.nan


COMPARED = [chrom for chrom in clr100.chromnames if chrom != 'chrY']
rows = []
chrom100 = ref_vec['chrom'].astype(str).to_numpy()
for chrom in COMPARED:
    s = chrom100 == chrom
    row = {'chromosome': chrom}
    for k in (1, 2, 3):
        row[f'r E{k}'] = pearson(app_vec[k][s], ref_vec[f'E{k}'].to_numpy(float)[s])
        eig_app = first(app_comp.loc[(app_comp['sequence'] == chrom) & (app_comp['component'] == f'E{k}'), 'eigenvalue'])
        eig_ref = first(ref_val.loc[ref_val['name'] == chrom, f'eigval{k}'])
        row[f'eigenvalue E{k}, relative difference'] = abs(eig_app / eig_ref - 1)
    e1a, e1b = app_vec[1][s], ref_vec['E1'].to_numpy(float)[s]
    ok = np.isfinite(e1a) & np.isfinite(e1b)
    row['A/B agreement'] = (np.sign(e1a[ok]) == np.sign(e1b[ok])).mean()
    phase = first(app_comp.loc[(app_comp['sequence'] == chrom) & (app_comp['component'] == 'E1'), 'r'])
    row['E1 against GC (app)'] = phase
    row['phasing'] = 'set' if abs(phase) >= 0.1 else 'ambiguous'
    rows.append(row)
cmp_table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
show(cmp_table)
```

On `{python} TEXT['cmp_subject']`, E1 correlates at r ≥ `{python} TEXT['cmp_min_r']`, eigenvalues

## 4 · P(s)

`--quantity expected --scope file`: per band of separations (factor 1.1), the balanced contacts of
every chromosome over the bin pairs that could hold them, at the band's pair-weighted mean separation,
from the app's default minimum separation of two bins — the diagonal and the one beside it left out,
as cooltools' own default leaves them out (`ignore_diags=2`). cooltools' per-diagonal sums
(`expected_cis`, every diagonal) are pooled over the same bands, each a run of consecutive diagonals
from the first the app kept, whose weighted mean is the separation the app writes.

```{python}
PS = WORK / 'ps'
YEAST_800 = f'{rel(YEAST)}::/resolutions/800'
PS_CASES = {'yeast Micro-C, 800 bp': ('yeast', YEAST_800, f'{YEAST}::/resolutions/800', 'yeast 800 bp'),
            'mouse Hi-C, 10 kb': ('mouse', MOUSE_10K, f'{MOUSE}::/resolutions/10000', 'mouse 10 kb')}
EXPECTED = script('cooltools_expected_cis')


def bands(n_valid, separations, binsize, first):
    """The run of consecutive diagonals behind each separation the app wrote: from `first`, then from
    where the last ended, the longest run whose valid-pixel-weighted mean matches it to its six written
    digits."""
    k = np.arange(len(n_valid), dtype=float)
    cn = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(n_valid)])
    ck = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(n_valid * k)])
    runs, lo = [], first
    for x in separations:
        tolerance = max(0.5, abs(x) * 5e-6)
        match = None
        for hi in range(lo + 1, len(n_valid) + 1):
            w = cn[hi] - cn[lo]
            if w <= 0:
                continue
            mean = (ck[hi] - ck[lo]) / w * binsize
            if abs(mean - x) <= tolerance:
                match = hi
            elif mean > x + tolerance:
                break
        if match is None:
            raise ValueError(f'no run of diagonals from {lo} has its mean at {x}')
        runs.append((lo, match))
        lo = match
    return runs


def kept_from(path):
    """The first diagonal the app kept: its minimum separation, as the table's header records it, and
    never the diagonal itself, which the expected leaves out whatever it says."""
    for line in open(path):
        if line.startswith('# param minSeparation:'):
            return max(1, int(float(line.split(':', 1)[1])))
    raise ValueError(f'{path} does not say its minimum separation')


ps = {}
for label, (slug, uri, local, short) in PS_CASES.items():
    mr('expected', uri, '--quantity', 'expected', '--scope', 'file', out=PS / slug, name=f'expected-{slug}',
       analysis='P(s)', label=short)
    reference(f'cooltools-expected-{slug}', 'P(s)', 'cooltools', [PYTHON, EXPECTED, uri, OUT, THREADS],
              out=PS / f'{slug}-cooltools.tsv', label=short, threads=THREADS)
    saved = one(PS / slug, '*.expected.ps.tsv')
    app = table(saved)
    cvd = pd.read_csv(PS / f'{slug}-cooltools.tsv', sep='\t')
    cvd['balanced.sum'] = cvd['balanced.sum'].fillna(0)
    ref = cvd.groupby('dist')[['n_valid', 'balanced.sum']].sum()
    n = ref['n_valid'].reindex(range(int(ref.index.max()) + 1), fill_value=0).to_numpy(float)
    total = ref['balanced.sum'].reindex(range(len(n)), fill_value=0).to_numpy(float)
    x, y = app.iloc[:, 0].to_numpy(float), app.iloc[:, 1].to_numpy(float)
    runs = bands(n, x, cooler.Cooler(local).binsize, kept_from(saved))
    pooled = np.array([total[a:b].sum() / n[a:b].sum() for a, b in runs])
    ps[label] = dict(x=x, app=y, ref=pooled, rel=np.abs(y / pooled - 1), reach=x.max(), first=runs[0][0])
show(pd.DataFrame([{'map': k, 'points': len(v['x']), 'first diagonal': v['first'],
                    'furthest separation (Mb)': v['reach'] / 1e6,
                    'relative difference, max': v['rel'].max()} for k, v in ps.items()]),
     **{'furthest separation (Mb)': '{:.1f}', 'relative difference, max': '{:.1e}'})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-ps
#| fig-cap: "P(s), chromosomix against cooltools.expected_cis pooled over the same bands. Top, the curves; bottom, the relative difference at every point."
TEXT['ps_max'] = f"{max(v['rel'].max() for v in ps.values()):.1e}"
TEXT['ps_points'] = f"{sum(len(v['x']) for v in ps.values())}"

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(11, 6.4), layout='constrained', height_ratios=[1.4, 1], sharex='col')
for col, (label, v) in enumerate(ps.items()):
    ax = axes[0, col]
    ax.plot(v['x'], v['ref'], color=REF, lw=3, label='cooltools, pooled')
    ax.scatter(v['x'], v['app'], s=14, color=APP_COLOUR, zorder=3, label='chromosomix')
    ax.set(xscale='log', yscale='log', ylabel='mean balanced contact per bin pair', title=label)
    ax.legend(loc='lower left')
    ax = axes[1, col]
    ax.scatter(v['x'], np.maximum(v['rel'], 1e-9), s=10, color=APP_COLOUR)
    ax.set(xscale='log', yscale='log', ylim=(1e-9, 1e-3), xlabel='separation (bp)',
           ylabel='|chromosomix / cooltools − 1|')
plt.show()
```

Over `{python} TEXT['ps_points']` points, from two bins to the longest chromosome, the relative
difference is at most `{python} TEXT['ps_max']` (float32).

```{python}
       f"max relative difference {TEXT['ps_max']} over {TEXT['ps_points']} points",
       'Identical (float32)', apps=['expected-yeast', 'expected-mouse'],
       refs=['cooltools-expected-yeast', 'cooltools-expected-mouse'])
```

## 5 · Peak calling with IDR (yapc)

yapc (Jänes et al. 2018): the concave regions of the pooled signal's smoothed second derivative, scored
in each replicate and tested for reproducibility by IDR. Both tools are given the two replicates cut to
chr19, interval for interval (yapc holds a whole genome's second derivative in memory). Reference:
yapc 0.1's command line with IDR 2.0.3, NumPy's random seed fixed. yapc breaks score ties at random,
so it is run with five seeds, and their spread is the yardstick for IDR.

| | chromosomix | yapc 0.1 |
|---|---|---|
| smoothing | `--width 150 --times 3` | `--smoothing-window-width 150 --smoothing-times 3` |
| narrowest region | `--minWidth 75` | `--min-concave-region-width 75` |
| regions given to IDR | `--truncate 100000` | `--truncate-idr-input 100000` |
| IDR threshold | `--idr 0.05`, and a count at each of yapc's six | one BED at each of 0.001–0.2 |

```{python}
YP = WORK / 'yapc'
REPS = [DATA / f'{path.stem}.chr19.bw' for path in ATAC]


def chr19(source, target):
    """The track with chr19 only, interval for interval."""
    if target.exists() and not REDO:
        return
    handle = pyBigWig.open(str(source))
    out = pyBigWig.open(str(target), 'w')
    out.addHeader([('chr19', handle.chroms()['chr19'])])
    entries = handle.intervals('chr19') or ()
    out.addEntries(['chr19'] * len(entries), [int(a) for a, _, _ in entries],
                   ends=[int(b) for _, b, _ in entries], values=[float(v) for _, _, v in entries])
    out.close()
    handle.close()


for source, target in zip(ATAC, REPS):
    chr19(source, target)
mr('peaks', '--signal', REPS[0], '--replicate', REPS[1], '--perPeak', '--width', 150, '--times', 3,
   '--minWidth', 75, '--truncate', 100000, '--idr', 0.05, out=YP / 'app', name='peaks',
   analysis='Peak calling (yapc, IDR)')
YAPC_SCRIPT = script('yapc_idr')
SEEDS = {seed: YP / f'seed{seed}' for seed in range(5)}
for seed, folder in SEEDS.items():
    reference(f'yapc-seed{seed}', 'Peak calling (yapc, IDR)', 'yapc 0.1', [
        str(YAPC_PYTHON), YAPC_SCRIPT, seed, OUT, 'cond', *REPS, '--smoothing-window-width', 150,
        '--smoothing-times', 3, '--min-concave-region-width', 75, '--truncate-idr-input', 100000],
        out=folder / 'yapc', made=folder / 'yapc_0.05.bed', env=YAPC_ENV, label=f'seed {seed}', bench=seed == 0)

THRESHOLDS = [0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2]
peaksall = pd.read_csv(SEEDS[0] / 'yapc_peaksall.tsv', sep='\t')
ref_tested = pd.read_csv(SEEDS[0] / 'yapc.tsv', sep='\t')
listing = table(one(YP / 'app', '*.peaks-list.tsv')).rename(columns={'sequence': 'chrom'})
counts_app = table(one(YP / 'app', '*.peaks-idr.tsv'))
called_app = pd.read_csv(one(YP / 'app', '*.bed'), sep='\t', header=None, comment='#',
                         names=['chrom', 'start', 'end', 'name', 'score', 'strand'])
key = ['chrom', 'start', 'end']
bounds = ['chrom', 'concave_start', 'concave_end']
m = listing.merge(ref_tested.drop(columns=['start', 'end']), left_on=key, right_on=bounds, how='outer',
                  indicator=True)
shared = m[m['_merge'] == 'both']
curvature = np.abs(np.r_[shared['curvature0'] - shared['cond_rep1_score'],
                         shared['curvature1'] - shared['cond_rep2_score']])


def bed(th, seed=0):
    out = pd.read_csv(SEEDS[seed] / f'yapc_{th}.bed', sep='\t', header=None, comment='#').iloc[:, :3]
    out.columns = key
    return out


called_ref = bed(0.05)
same_called = called_app[key].merge(called_ref, on=key)
idr = called_app.merge(ref_tested, left_on=key, right_on=bounds)
# −log10 IDR over the peaks called: the app against each seed, and the seeds against one another.
runs = {seed: pd.read_csv(folder / 'yapc.tsv', sep='\t').set_index(bounds)['cond_globalIDR']
        for seed, folder in SEEDS.items()}
app_idr = called_app.set_index(key)['score'].rename_axis(bounds)
idr_app = [np.abs(runs[seed].reindex(app_idr.index) - app_idr).max() for seed in SEEDS]
idr_self = [np.abs(runs[a].reindex(app_idr.index) - runs[b].reindex(app_idr.index)).max()
            for a in SEEDS for b in SEEDS if a < b]
note = next(n for n in NOTES['peaks'] if 'concave region' in n)
found_app, wide_app = (int(re.search(rf'([\d,]+) {w}', note).group(1).replace(',', ''))
                       for w in ('concave region', 'at least'))
wide_ref = int(((peaksall['concave_end'] - peaksall['concave_start']) >= 75).sum())
measures({
    'concave regions, chromosomix / yapc': f'{found_app:,} / {len(peaksall):,}',
    'at least 75 bp, chromosomix / yapc': f'{wide_app:,} / {wide_ref:,}',
    'given to IDR, chromosomix / yapc': f'{len(listing):,} / {len(ref_tested):,}',
    'same bounds; in one only': f"{len(shared):,}; {int((m['_merge'] != 'both').sum())}",
    'same summit': f"{(shared['summit'] == shared['mode']).mean():.2%}",
    'curvature, max |difference| (two decimals written)': f'{curvature.max():.4f}',
    'peaks at IDR ≤ 0.05, chromosomix / yapc; same': f'{len(called_app):,} / {len(called_ref):,}; {len(same_called):,}',
    '−log10 IDR of those peaks, max |difference| to each yapc seed': f'{min(idr_app):.1e} to {max(idr_app):.1e}',
    '−log10 IDR, yapc seeds against one another': f'{min(idr_self):.1e} to {max(idr_self):.1e}',
})
```

```{python}
def counted(th):
    values = sorted({len(bed(th, seed)) for seed in SEEDS})
    return f'{values[0]:,}' if len(values) == 1 else f'{values[0]:,}–{values[-1]:,}'


show(pd.DataFrame([{'IDR ≤': th, f'yapc 0.1, seeds 0–{len(SEEDS) - 1}': counted(th),
                    'chromosomix': f"{int(counts_app.loc[np.isclose(counts_app['threshold'], th), 'peaks'].iloc[0]):,}"}
                   for th in THRESHOLDS]), **{'IDR ≤': '{:g}'})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-yapc
#| fig-cap: "yapc with IDR on two mouse ATAC-seq replicates, chr19. a, the curvature of every region given to IDR, both replicates; b, −log10 IDR of every peak called at IDR ≤ 0.05."
TEXT['yapc_n'] = f'{len(shared):,}'
TEXT['yapc_curv'] = f'{curvature.max():.4f}'
TEXT['yapc_called'] = f'{len(same_called):,}'
TEXT['yapc_idr'] = f'{max(idr_app):.1e}'
TEXT['yapc_self'] = f'{max(idr_self):.1e}'
TEXT['yapc_counts'] = 'every one' if all(
    len(bed(th, seed)) == int(counts_app.loc[np.isclose(counts_app['threshold'], th), 'peaks'].iloc[0])
    for th in THRESHOLDS for seed in SEEDS) else 'not every one'
# Within the spread of yapc's own runs, the six significant digits the app's BED writes aside.
IDR_WITHIN = max(idr_app) <= max(idr_self) + 1e-5

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.4), layout='constrained')
agreement(axes[0], np.r_[shared['cond_rep1_score'], shared['cond_rep2_score']],
          np.r_[shared['curvature0'], shared['curvature1']], 'yapc 0.1', 'chromosomix', 'a  curvature')
agreement(axes[1], idr['cond_globalIDR'].to_numpy(float), idr['score'].to_numpy(float), 'yapc 0.1',
          'chromosomix', 'b  −log10 IDR, called peaks')
plt.show()
```

The same `{python} TEXT['yapc_n']` regions go to IDR, with the same summits and curvatures within the
two decimals written. `{python} TEXT['yapc_called']` peaks pass IDR ≤ 0.05 in both, the same regions;
their −log10 IDR is within `{python} TEXT['yapc_idr']` of every yapc run, whose five seeds differ from
one another by up to `{python} TEXT['yapc_self']`. The counts agree with every seed at
`{python} TEXT['yapc_counts']` of yapc's six thresholds.

```{python}
record('Peak calling (yapc, IDR)', 'mouse ATAC-seq, 2 replicates, chr19', f'yapc {YAPC}, idr {IDR}',
       f"{TEXT['yapc_n']} regions, same bounds and summits; {TEXT['yapc_called']} peaks at IDR ≤ 0.05; "
       f"−log10 IDR within {TEXT['yapc_idr']} of 5 yapc seeds (seeds among themselves: up to {TEXT['yapc_self']})",
       'Identical peaks' + ('; IDR within yapc\'s seed-to-seed spread' if IDR_WITHIN else ''),
       apps=['peaks'], refs=[f'yapc-seed{seed}' for seed in SEEDS])
```

## 6 · Loops (chromosight)

Chromosight's loop preset (`kernels/loops.json`) in both; calls matched by bin pair, p- and q-values
read from each call's detail.

```{python}
LP = WORK / 'loops'
mr('chromosight', YEAST_800, '--pattern', 'loops', out=LP / 'app', name='chromosight', analysis='Loops (chromosight)')
reference('chromosight', 'Loops (chromosight)', 'chromosight',
          [CHROMOSIGHT, 'detect', '--pattern', 'loops', '--threads', THREADS, YEAST_800, OUT],
          out=LP / 'chromosight' / 'loops', made=LP / 'chromosight' / 'loops.tsv', threads=THREADS)

ref_loops = pd.read_csv(LP / 'chromosight' / 'loops.tsv', sep='\t')
app_loops = table(one(LP / 'app', '*.chromosight-patterns.tsv'))
for key_ in ('p', 'q'):
    app_loops[key_] = app_loops['detail'].str.extract(rf'\b{key_} ([0-9.e+-]+)')[0].astype(float)
m = app_loops.merge(ref_loops, on=['chrom1', 'start1', 'chrom2', 'start2'], how='outer', indicator=True,
                    suffixes=('_app', '_ref'))
shared = m[m['_merge'] == 'both']
# chromosight writes p and q to ten decimals: compared where that leaves four significant digits.
readable = shared[shared['pvalue'] >= 1e-6]
readable_q = shared[shared['qvalue'] >= 1e-6]
measures({
    'loops, chromosomix / chromosight': f'{len(app_loops):,} / {len(ref_loops):,}',
    'same bin pair; in one only': f"{len(shared):,}; {int((m['_merge'] != 'both').sum())}",
    'score, max |difference|': f"{np.abs(shared['score_app'] - shared['score_ref']).max():.1e}",
    f'p, max relative difference ({len(readable):,} loops with p ≥ 1e-6)':
        f"{np.abs(readable['p'] / readable['pvalue'] - 1).max():.1e}",
    f'q, max relative difference ({len(readable_q):,} loops with q ≥ 1e-6)':
        f"{np.abs(readable_q['q'] / readable_q['qvalue'] - 1).max():.1e}",
})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-loops
#| fig-cap: "Loops, yeast Micro-C at 800 bp. a, the score of every loop both call; b, their p-values where chromosight's ten decimals leave four significant digits."
TEXT['loops_n'] = f'{len(shared):,}'
TEXT['loops_only'] = f"{int((m['_merge'] != 'both').sum())}"
TEXT['loops_score'] = f"{np.abs(shared['score_app'] - shared['score_ref']).max():.1e}"
TEXT['loops_p'] = f"{np.abs(readable['p'] / readable['pvalue'] - 1).max():.1e}"

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.4), layout='constrained')
ax = axes[0]
ax.scatter(shared['score_ref'], shared['score_app'], s=8, color=APP_COLOUR, alpha=0.6, lw=0)

plt.show()
```

significant digits printed in a call's detail.

```{python}
       f"{TEXT['loops_n']} loops, the same bin pairs; scores within {TEXT['loops_score']}",
```

## 7 · Reproducibility (HiCRep)

The stratum-adjusted correlation (Yang et al. 2017) as `hicrep` 0.2.6 computes it: each map's upper
triangle, the main diagonal and every diagonal past the furthest compared set to zero, a 2D mean filter
of half-width `h`, a Pearson correlation per diagonal over the positions where either map has a contact,
and weights `(n + 1)/12`. Every pair of the three maps, on every chromosome longer than the furthest
diagonal compared.

| | chromosomix | hicrep |
|---|---|---|
| counts | raw, `--no-balance` | raw (`balance=False`) |
| smoothing | `--smooth 1` | `h=1` |
| furthest diagonal | `--maxDistance 50` (5 Mb) | `dBPMax=5_000_000` |
| depth | as read | `bDownSample=False` |

```{python}
HR = WORK / 'hicrep'
RES, STRATA = 100_000, 50
LABELS = [path.stem for path in CHICKEN]
URIS = {label: f'{rel(path)}::/resolutions/{RES}' for label, path in zip(LABELS, CHICKEN)}
SEQS = [c for c, length in cooler.Cooler(f'{CHICKEN[0]}::/resolutions/{RES}').chromsizes.items()
        if length >= (STRATA + 1) * RES]
PAIRS = f'{len(LABELS)} maps, {len(LABELS) * (len(LABELS) - 1) // 2} pairs'
against = [a for label in LABELS[1:] for a in ('--against', URIS[label])]
mr('hicrep', URIS[LABELS[0]], *against, '--maxDistance', STRATA, '--smooth', 1, '--no-balance',
   '--sequences', ','.join(SEQS), out=HR / 'app', name='hicrep', analysis='Reproducibility (HiCRep)', label=PAIRS)
reference('hicrep', 'Reproducibility (HiCRep)', 'hicrep',
          [PYTHON, script('hicrep_scc'), OUT, ','.join(SEQS), *[f'{label}={URIS[label]}' for label in LABELS]],
          out=HR / 'hicrep.tsv', label=PAIRS)

names = {'This map': LABELS[0], **{path.name: label for label, path in zip(LABELS, CHICKEN)}}
app_scc = table(one(HR / 'app', '*.hicrep-sequences.tsv'))
app_scc['a'], app_scc['b'] = app_scc['a'].map(names), app_scc['b'].map(names)


def unordered(frame):
    order = {label: i for i, label in enumerate(LABELS)}
    swap = frame['a'].map(order) > frame['b'].map(order)
    frame.loc[swap, ['a', 'b']] = frame.loc[swap, ['b', 'a']].to_numpy()
    return frame


scc = (unordered(app_scc[['a', 'b', 'sequence', 'scc']].rename(columns={'scc': 'chromosomix'}))
       .merge(unordered(pd.read_csv(HR / 'hicrep.tsv', sep='\t')), on=['a', 'b', 'sequence']))
scc_diff = scc['chromosomix'] - scc['hicrep']
measures({
    'values (pairs × chromosomes)': f'{len(scc):,}',
    'mean difference': f'{scc_diff.mean():+.1e}',
    'max |difference|': f'{scc_diff.abs().max():.1e}',
    'Pearson r': f"{pearson(scc['chromosomix'].to_numpy(), scc['hicrep'].to_numpy()):.6f}",
})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-hicrep
#| fig-cap: "HiCRep on three chicken Hi-C maps at 100 kb, every pair, every chromosome of at least 5.1 Mb. a, chromosomix against hicrep; b, their difference, value by value."
TEXT['hr_n'] = f'{len(scc)}'
TEXT['hr_max'] = f'{scc_diff.abs().max():.1e}'

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.2), layout='constrained')
ax = axes[0]
ax.scatter(scc['hicrep'], scc['chromosomix'], s=10, color=APP_COLOUR, alpha=0.6, lw=0)
identity(ax, 0, 1)
ax.set(xlim=(0, 1), ylim=(0, 1), xlabel='hicrep SCC', ylabel='chromosomix SCC', title='a  every value')
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax = axes[1]
ax.hist(scc_diff * 1e5, bins=np.linspace(-6, 6, 49), color=APP_COLOUR)
for edge in (-5, 5):
    ax.axvline(edge, color=INK2, lw=1, ls=(0, (4, 3)))
ax.set(xlabel='chromosomix − hicrep (×10⁻⁵)', ylabel='pairs × chromosomes',
       title='b  difference; dashed, the rounding of four decimals')
plt.show()
```

Over `{python} TEXT['hr_n']` values the two differ by at most `{python} TEXT['hr_max']`, the rounding
of the four decimals the app writes an SCC to.

```{python}
record('Reproducibility (HiCRep)', 'chicken Hi-C, 3 maps, 100 kb, raw counts', f"hicrep {VERSIONS['hicrep']}",
       f"within {TEXT['hr_max']} over {TEXT['hr_n']} values (4 decimals written)",
       'Identical', apps=['hicrep'], refs=['hicrep'])
```

## 8 · 3D model (pastis-NB)

Counts drawn from a negative binomial of mean `β·bᵢ·bⱼ·d^−α`, α = 3, with `bᵢ = 1/wᵢ` from the file's
balancing weights and zeros taken as counts. Reference: pastis (GitHub `6888ac2`; Varoquaux, Noble &
Vert 2023) through its own functions — the dispersion fitted against the mean
(`ExponentialDispersion(degree=1)`), an MDS start, `negative_binomial_structure.estimate_X` — on the same
beads (bins with a weight and a contact). The app departs on purpose: its dispersion is a moment
estimate per separation, its start ShRec3D's MDS. A structure has no unique solution, so pastis from
three seeds is the yardstick. chromosomix runs its default 150 steps.

```{python}
P3 = WORK / 'pastis'
YEAST_12K = f'{rel(YEAST)}::/resolutions/12800'
mr('reconstruct3d', YEAST_12K, '--method', 'nb', '--alpha', 3, out=P3 / 'app', name='reconstruct3d',
   analysis='3D model (pastis-NB)', label='150 steps')
PASTIS = script('pastis_nb')
for seed in (0, 1, 2):
    reference(f'pastis-seed{seed}', '3D model (pastis-NB)', 'pastis', [PYTHON, PASTIS, YEAST_12K, OUT, seed],
              out=P3 / f'pastis-seed{seed}.npy', label=f'seed {seed}', bench=seed == 0)

clr_y = cooler.Cooler(f'{YEAST}::/resolutions/12800')
raw_y = clr_y.matrix(balance=False)[:].astype(float)
w_y = clr_y.bins()['weight'][:].to_numpy(float)
KEEP = np.isfinite(w_y) & (raw_y.sum(axis=0) > 0)
beads = clr_y.bins()[['chrom', 'start']][:][KEEP].reset_index(drop=True)
bead_chrom = beads['chrom'].astype(str).to_numpy()


def app_model(folder):
    bed3d = pd.read_csv(one(folder, '*.bed3d'), sep='\t', comment='#', header=None,
                        names=['chrom', 'start', 'end', 'x', 'y', 'z'])
    return beads.merge(bed3d, on=['chrom', 'start'], how='left')[['x', 'y', 'z']].to_numpy(float)


MODELS = {'chromosomix': app_model(P3 / 'app'),
          **{f'pastis, seed {s}': np.load(P3 / f'pastis-seed{s}.npy') for s in (0, 1, 2)}}
assert all(model.shape == (KEEP.sum(), 3) and np.isfinite(model).all() for model in MODELS.values()), \
    'a bead is missing from a model'
```

```{python}
from scipy.spatial import procrustes
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist, squareform

same = squareform(np.equal.outer(bead_chrom, bead_chrom).astype(int), checks=False).astype(bool)
dist = {name: pdist(model) for name, model in MODELS.items()}
contacts = squareform(raw_y[np.ix_(KEEP, KEEP)] * np.outer(w_y[KEEP], w_y[KEEP]), checks=False)
seen = contacts > 0


def per_chromosome_disparity(a, b):
    return np.median([procrustes(a[bead_chrom == c], b[bead_chrom == c])[2] for c in pd.unique(bead_chrom)])


rows = []
names_ = list(MODELS)
for i, a in enumerate(names_):
    for b in names_[i + 1:]:
        rows.append({'models': f'{a} / {b}',
                     'kind': 'pastis vs pastis' if a.startswith('pastis') else 'chromosomix vs pastis',
                     'within chromosomes, Spearman ρ': stats.spearmanr(dist[a][same], dist[b][same])[0],
                     'between chromosomes, Spearman ρ': stats.spearmanr(dist[a][~same], dist[b][~same])[0],
                     'per-chromosome Procrustes disparity': per_chromosome_disparity(MODELS[a], MODELS[b])})
models_table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
fit_table = pd.DataFrame([{'model': name, 'fit, all pairs': stats.spearmanr(1 / d[seen], contacts[seen])[0],
                           'fit, within chromosomes': stats.spearmanr(1 / d[seen & same], contacts[seen & same])[0]}
                          for name, d in dist.items()])
display(show(models_table, precision=3))
show(fit_table, precision=3)
```

The fit is the Spearman correlation of `1/d` with the balanced contacts over every pair of beads the
map counted.

```{python}
#| label: fig-pastis
#| fig-cap: "pastis-NB, yeast Micro-C at 12.8 kb. a, distances within chromosomes, chromosomix against pastis' first seed, each over its model's median distance between neighbouring beads; b, how alike two models are, within and between chromosomes."
cross = models_table[models_table['kind'] == 'chromosomix vs pastis']
selfs = models_table[models_table['kind'] == 'pastis vs pastis']


def spread(frame, column, digits):
    return f"{frame[column].min():.{digits}f}–{frame[column].max():.{digits}f}"


TEXT['p3_beads'] = f'{KEEP.sum():,}'
TEXT['p3_intra_cross'] = spread(cross, 'within chromosomes, Spearman ρ', 3)
TEXT['p3_intra_self'] = spread(selfs, 'within chromosomes, Spearman ρ', 3)
TEXT['p3_inter_cross'] = spread(cross, 'between chromosomes, Spearman ρ', 2)
TEXT['p3_inter_self'] = spread(selfs, 'between chromosomes, Spearman ρ', 2)
fits = fit_table.set_index('model')['fit, all pairs']
TEXT['p3_fit_app'] = f"{fits['chromosomix']:.3f}"
pastis_fits = fits[[n for n in fits.index if n.startswith('pastis')]]
TEXT['p3_fit_pastis'] = f"{pastis_fits.min():.3f}–{pastis_fits.max():.3f}"
within = fit_table.set_index('model')['fit, within chromosomes']
pastis_within = within[[n for n in within.index if n.startswith('pastis')]]
TEXT['p3_fit_app_within'] = f"{within['chromosomix']:.3f}"
TEXT['p3_fit_pastis_within'] = f"{pastis_within.min():.3f}–{pastis_within.max():.3f}"


def versus(app, reference_):
    return 'better than' if app > reference_.max() else 'less well than' if app < reference_.min() else 'as well as'


TEXT['p3_within_word'] = versus(within['chromosomix'], pastis_within)
TEXT['p3_all_word'] = versus(fits['chromosomix'], pastis_fits)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.6), layout='constrained', width_ratios=[1, 1.15])


def scaled(model):
    step = np.median(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(model, axis=0), axis=1)[bead_chrom[1:] == bead_chrom[:-1]])
    return pdist(model) / step


agreement(axes[0], scaled(MODELS['pastis, seed 0'])[same], scaled(MODELS['chromosomix'])[same],
          'pastis, seed 0', 'chromosomix', 'a  distances within chromosomes', scale='log')
ax = axes[1]
for col, metric in enumerate(('within chromosomes, Spearman ρ', 'between chromosomes, Spearman ρ')):
    for offset, frame, colour, label in ((-0.12, cross, APP_COLOUR, 'chromosomix vs pastis'),
                                         (0.12, selfs, REF, 'pastis vs pastis')):
        ax.scatter(np.full(len(frame), col + offset), frame[metric], s=36, color=colour,
                   label=label if col == 0 else None, zorder=3)
ax.set_xticks([0, 1], ['within chromosomes', 'between chromosomes'])
ax.set(xlim=(-0.5, 1.5), ylim=(0, 1.02), ylabel='Spearman ρ of pairwise distances', title='b  how alike two runs are')
ax.legend(loc='lower left')
plt.show()
```

On `{python} TEXT['p3_beads']` beads, distances within chromosomes correlate with pastis' at
ρ = `{python} TEXT['p3_intra_cross']`, against `{python} TEXT['p3_intra_self']` between pastis seeds;
between chromosomes at `{python} TEXT['p3_inter_cross']` (`{python} TEXT['p3_inter_self']`).
chromosomix's model fits the contacts within chromosomes `{python} TEXT['p3_within_word']` pastis'
(`{python} TEXT['p3_fit_app_within']` against `{python} TEXT['p3_fit_pastis_within']`), and over all
pairs, the chromosomes' arrangement included, `{python} TEXT['p3_all_word']` pastis'
(`{python} TEXT['p3_fit_app']` against `{python} TEXT['p3_fit_pastis']`).

## 9 · Coverage

Per bin, the contacts of every pixel that touches it: within its own chromosome (cis) and over the
genome (total). cooltools' `coverage` adds a pixel at both of its ends, `bincount(bin1) +
bincount(bin2)`, so a pixel on the diagonal is counted twice; the app counts it once, a bin's contact
with itself being one contact. cooltools' value less the bin's own diagonal pixel is therefore the
app's, and that is what is compared, raw and balanced.

| | chromosomix | cooltools |
|---|---|---|
| counts | raw, the default, and `--balance` | `clr_weight_name=None`, and `'weight'` |
| diagonals | every one | `ignore_diags=0` |
| outputs | `--cis --trans --fraction`, with total | cis and total |

```{python}
COV = WORK / 'coverage'
WANTED = ['--cis', '--trans', '--fraction']
mr('coverage', MOUSE_10K, *WANTED, out=COV / 'raw', name='coverage-raw', analysis='Coverage', label='raw')
mr('coverage', MOUSE_10K, *WANTED, '--balance', out=COV / 'balanced', name='coverage-balanced',
   analysis='Coverage', label='balanced')
for kind, extra in (('raw', []), ('balanced', ['weight'])):
    reference(f'cooltools-coverage-{kind}', 'Coverage', 'cooltools',
              [PYTHON, script('cooltools_coverage'), MOUSE_10K, OUT, THREADS, *extra],
              out=COV / f'cooltools-{kind}.tsv', label=kind, threads=THREADS)


def self_contacts(clr, chunk=10_000_000):
    """Each bin's pixel on the diagonal, copies of it added, and then how many pixels the file stores
    twice — one array, the count last. Read whole rows at a time, so that a pixel and its copy, which
    are in one row, are always read together."""
    with clr.open('r') as group:
        offsets = group['indexes/bin1_offset'][:]
    n = len(offsets) - 1
    diagonal, twice = np.zeros(n), 0
    rows = np.unique(np.r_[np.searchsorted(offsets, np.arange(0, offsets[-1], chunk)), n])
    for a, b in zip(rows[:-1], rows[1:]):
        px = clr.pixels()[int(offsets[a]):int(offsets[b])]
        b1, b2 = px['bin1_id'].to_numpy(), px['bin2_id'].to_numpy()
        on = b1 == b2
        diagonal += np.bincount(b1[on], weights=px['count'].to_numpy(float)[on], minlength=n)
        pairs = b1.astype(np.int64) * n + b2
        twice += len(pairs) - len(np.unique(pairs))
    return np.append(diagonal, twice)


held = cached(COV / 'self-contacts.npy', lambda: self_contacts(clr10))
diagonal, stored_twice = held[:-1], int(held[-1])
weight10 = bins10['weight'].to_numpy(float)
coverage = {}
for kind, own in (('raw', diagonal), ('balanced', diagonal * weight10 ** 2)):
    ref = pd.read_csv(COV / f'cooltools-{kind}.tsv', sep='\t')
    app = {track: table(one(COV / kind, f'*.coverage-{track}.tsv'))['value'].to_numpy(float)
           for track in ('cis', 'total', 'trans', 'fraction')}
    cis, total = ref['cis'].to_numpy(float) - own, ref['total'].to_numpy(float) - own
    with np.errstate(invalid='ignore', divide='ignore'):
        fraction = np.where(total > 0, cis / total, np.nan)
    both = np.isfinite(app['total']) & np.isfinite(total)
    coverage[kind] = dict(
        app=app, ref=ref, cis=cis, total=total, both=both,
        gaps=(int((~np.isfinite(app['total'])).sum()), int((~np.isfinite(total)).sum())),
        same_gaps=bool((np.isfinite(app['total']) == np.isfinite(total)).all()),
        absolute=max(np.abs(app[t][both] - v[both]).max() for t, v in (('cis', cis), ('total', total))),
        relative=max(relative_difference(app[t][both], v[both])[v[both] != 0].max() for t, v in (('cis', cis), ('total', total))),
        trans=np.nanmax(np.abs(app['trans'] - (total - cis))),
        fraction=np.nanmax(np.abs(app['fraction'] - fraction)))
raw, balanced = coverage['raw'], coverage['balanced']
measures({
    'bins': f'{len(bins10):,}',
    'raw cis and total, max |difference| (cooltools less the diagonal)': f"{raw['absolute']:g}",
    'balanced cis and total, max relative difference': f"{balanced['relative']:.1e}",
    'trans (total less cis) and cis fraction, max |difference|':
        f"{max(raw['trans'], balanced['trans']):.1e}; {max(raw['fraction'], balanced['fraction']):.1e}",
    'balanced bins without a value, chromosomix / cooltools':
        f"{balanced['gaps'][0]:,} / {balanced['gaps'][1]:,} ({'the same bins' if balanced['same_gaps'] else 'not the same bins'})",
    'pixels the file stores twice (both tools add the copies)': f'{stored_twice:,}',
})
```

```{python}

#| fig-cap: "Coverage at 10 kb. a, total coverage of every bin, raw; b, balanced; c, chr11, 30–40 Mb, raw: cooltools as it writes it, and less each bin's own diagonal pixel."
TEXT['cov_n'] = f"{raw['both'].sum():,}"
TEXT['cov_raw'] = f"{raw['absolute']:g}"
TEXT['cov_bal'] = f"{balanced['relative']:.1e}"
TEXT['cov_twice'] = f'{stored_twice:,}'
TEXT['cov_gaps'] = f"{balanced['gaps'][0]:,}"
TEXT['cov_same'] = 'the same' if raw['absolute'] == 0 else 'not the same'
TEXT['cov_gap_words'] = 'the same' if balanced['same_gaps'] else 'not the same'

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(11, 7.2), layout='constrained')
grid = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1.15, 1])
agreement(fig.add_subplot(grid[0, 0]), raw['total'], raw['app']['total'], 'cooltools less the diagonal',
          'chromosomix', 'a  raw', scale='log')

          'chromosomix', 'b  balanced', scale='log')
ax = fig.add_subplot(grid[1, :])
lo, _ = clr10.extent('chr11')
stretch = slice(lo + 3_000, lo + 4_000)
x = bins10['start'].to_numpy()[stretch] / 1e6
ax.plot(x, raw['ref']['total'].to_numpy(float)[stretch], color=INK2, lw=0.8, label='cooltools, as written')
ax.plot(x, raw['total'][stretch], color=REF, lw=3, label='cooltools less the diagonal')
```

## 10 · Virtual 4C

A viewpoint's row of the balanced map, over the whole genome. cooltools' `virtual4c` takes the stored
pixels between the viewpoint and each chromosome and averages them bin by bin; for a viewpoint one bin
wide that is the row itself, with no value where the map stores no contact, nor on the viewpoint. The
app sums the viewpoint's rows and writes 0 where nothing is stored; `--no-cis` reads every
chromosome. The viewpoints are the 10 kb bins holding the 5′-most TSS of three genes of pluripotency,
*Sox2*, *Nanog* and *Pou5f1*.

| | chromosomix | cooltools |
|---|---|---|
| viewpoint | `--anchor`, one bin | `viewpoint`, one bin |
| scope | `--no-cis`: the whole genome | the whole genome |
| counts | balanced (the file's weights) | `clr_weight_name='weight'` |

```{python}
V4C = WORK / 'virtual4c'


def promoter_bin(gene, binsize=10_000):
    """The bin holding a gene's 5′-most TSS."""
    rows = TRANSCRIPTS[TRANSCRIPTS['gene'] == gene]
    plus = rows['strand'].iloc[0] == '+'
    tss = int(rows['start'].min() if plus else rows['end'].max() - 1)
    return rows['chrom'].iloc[0], tss // binsize * binsize, tss // binsize * binsize + binsize


VIEWPOINTS = {gene: promoter_bin(gene) for gene in ('Sox2', 'Nanog', 'Pou5f1')}
for gene, (chrom, start, end) in VIEWPOINTS.items():
    # Timed at Sox2 alone: the other two viewpoints are the same computation from another bin.
    mr('fourc', MOUSE_10K, '--anchor', f'{chrom}:{start + 1:,}-{end:,}', '--no-cis', out=V4C / gene,
       name=f'fourc-{gene}', analysis='Virtual 4C', label=gene, bench=gene == 'Sox2')
    reference(f'cooltools-virtual4c-{gene}', 'Virtual 4C', 'cooltools',
              [PYTHON, script('cooltools_virtual4c'), MOUSE_10K, f'{chrom}:{start}-{end}', OUT, THREADS],
              out=V4C / f'cooltools-{gene}.tsv', label=gene, threads=THREADS, bench=gene == 'Sox2')

profiles, rows = {}, []
for gene, (chrom, start, end) in VIEWPOINTS.items():
    a = table(one(V4C / gene, '*.fourc-*.tsv'))['value'].to_numpy(float)
    b = pd.read_csv(V4C / f'cooltools-{gene}.tsv', sep='\t')['balanced'].to_numpy(float)
    at = clr10.offset(f'{chrom}:{start}-{end}')
    both, app_only = np.isfinite(a) & np.isfinite(b), np.isfinite(a) & ~np.isfinite(b)
    zero = app_only & (a == 0)
    profiles[gene] = dict(app=a, ref=b, at=at, chrom=chrom, both=both)
    rows.append({'viewpoint': f'{gene}, {chrom}:{start + 1:,}-{end:,}', 'bins both report': int(both.sum()),
                 'max relative difference': relative_difference(a[both], b[both]).max(),
                 'only chromosomix: 0': int(zero.sum()),
                 'only chromosomix: the viewpoint': int(app_only[at] and not zero[at]),
                 'only chromosomix: anything else': int((app_only & ~zero).sum() - (app_only[at] and not zero[at])),
                 'only cooltools': int((np.isfinite(b) & ~np.isfinite(a)).sum()),
                 'no value in chromosomix, at a dropped bin': f"{int((~np.isfinite(a) & np.isnan(weight10)).sum()):,} of {int((~np.isfinite(a)).sum()):,}"})
v4c_table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
show(v4c_table, **{'max relative difference': '{:.1e}'})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-virtual4c

TEXT['v4c_n'] = f"{v4c_table['bins both report'].sum():,}"
TEXT['v4c_max'] = f"{v4c_table['max relative difference'].max():.1e}"
TEXT['v4c_zero'] = f"{v4c_table['only chromosomix: 0'].sum():,}"
TEXT['v4c_other'] = ('and nothing else' if v4c_table['only chromosomix: anything else'].sum() == 0
                     else f"and {v4c_table['only chromosomix: anything else'].sum():,} bins besides")
V4C_OK = (v4c_table['only chromosomix: anything else'].sum() == 0) & (v4c_table['only cooltools'].sum() == 0)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(12, 3.6), layout='constrained', width_ratios=[1, 1, 1, 0.9])
for ax, (letter, (gene, v)) in zip(axes, zip('abc', profiles.items())):
    reach = slice(v['at'] - 100, v['at'] + 101)
    x = (np.arange(len(v['app']))[reach] - v['at']) * 10
    a, b = v['app'][reach].copy(), v['ref'][reach].copy()
    a[100] = np.nan
    ax.scatter(x[b > 0], b[b > 0], s=26, color=REF, label='cooltools', zorder=2)
    ax.scatter(x[a > 0], a[a > 0], s=6, color=APP_COLOUR, label='chromosomix', zorder=3)
    ax.set(yscale='log', xlabel=f"from the {gene} viewpoint (kb), {v['chrom']}", title=f'{letter}  {gene}')
axes[0].set_ylabel('balanced contacts')
```

```{python}
       'Identical (float32)' if V4C_OK else 'Differs', apps=[f'fourc-{g}' for g in VIEWPOINTS],
```

## 11 · Aggregate peak analysis (coolpuppy)

The mean window about a set of loops. The loops are chromosight's own calls on this map
(`chromosight detect`, its loop preset), given to both tools as one BEDPE; each window runs 5 bins
either side of a loop, ±50 kb. Both cut a window as coolpuppy does by default: from the upper triangle
only — a window that crosses the diagonal holds the same contacts twice there, once above it and once
mirrored below — with the main diagonal and the one beside it left out (`min_diag=2`); and both
leave out every loop nearer the diagonal than twice the flank and two bins (`mindist='auto'`), which
is where a window would start to reach those two diagonals. That floor is coolpuppy's default and
not the app's, whose *nearest loop* is five bins unless told otherwise, so the app is given it,
`--minDist 12` — as it is given the window, the diagonals left out and the normalisation, each at
coolpuppy's value rather than at a default of its own. Both run at coolpuppy's defaults, and then
again with every loop (`mindist=0`, `--minDist 0`): those are the windows that reach the diagonal.

Six pileups are compared cell for cell, gap for gap: raw and over the expected — each window divided
cell by cell by its chromosome's expected at that cell's own diagonal before the mean, the expected
being cooltools' `expected_cis` from § 4, which coolpuppy reads as `balanced.avg` — at coolpuppy's
defaults and with every loop; and the same two on the diagonal, at every loop anchor. Then the
distance-matched normalisation: each pileup over the pileup of controls, five per loop, shifted along
the diagonal by 50 to 500 bins either way — against coolpuppy's own shifted controls over the same
range. Both draw their controls at random, so each is run with five seeds.

| | chromosomix | coolpuppy |
|---|---|---|
| window | `--mode fixed --window 5` (bins either side) | `flank=50_000` |
| near the diagonal | `--minDiag 2 --minDist 12`: twice `--window` and 2 | nothing: `min_diag` is 2, and `mindist` `'auto'`, by default |
| every loop | `--minDist 0` | `mindist=0` |
| raw | `--norm none` | `ooe=False` |
| over the expected | `--norm oe` | `expected_df=` § 4's table, `ooe=True` |
| on the diagonal | `--anchors features --features anchors.bed` | `features_format='bed'`, `local=True` |
| controls | `--norm matched --controls 5 --minShift 50 --maxShift 500` | `nshifts=5`, `minshift=500_000`, `maxshift=5_005_000` |

```{python}
from itertools import combinations, product

APA = WORK / 'apa'
FLANK = 5
reference('chromosight-mouse', 'Aggregate peak analysis', 'chromosight',
          [CHROMOSIGHT, 'detect', '--pattern', 'loops', '--threads', THREADS, MOUSE_10K, OUT],
          out=APA / 'loops', made=APA / 'loops.tsv', label='the loops, called', threads=THREADS, bench=False)
called = pd.read_csv(APA / 'loops.tsv', sep='\t')
apart = ((called['start2'] - called['start1']) // clr10.binsize).to_numpy()
LOOPS, ANCHORS = APA / 'loops.bedpe', APA / 'anchors.bed'
called[['chrom1', 'start1', 'end1', 'chrom2', 'start2', 'end2']].to_csv(LOOPS, sep='\t', header=False, index=False)
ends = [called[[f'chrom{k}', f'start{k}', f'end{k}']].set_axis(['chrom', 'start', 'end'], axis=1) for k in (1, 2)]
anchors = pd.concat(ends).drop_duplicates().sort_values(['chrom', 'start'])
anchors.to_csv(ANCHORS, sep='\t', header=False, index=False)
# A window reaches the first two diagonals where its loop is nearer than twice the flank and two, which
# is also where coolpuppy's default floor is, `mindist='auto'`; the app's own is five bins, so it is
# given this one. With every loop, the lower-left corner, nearest the diagonal, comes only from the
# loops whose windows do not.
MIN_DIAG, MIN_DIST = 2, 2 * FLANK + 2
reaching = int((apart < MIN_DIST).sum())
cornered = int((apart - 2 * FLANK >= 2).sum())
PILEUP = script('coolpuppy_pileup')
EXPECTED_MOUSE = PS / 'mouse-cooltools.tsv'
#: name: (label, chromosomix's arguments, coolpuppy's features and options). The app's window, its
#: diagonals left out, its nearest loop and its normalisation are named at coolpuppy's values: the
#: app's own defaults are not all coolpuppy's, and a default can move.
CUTS = {
    'raw': ('raw', ['--pairs', LOOPS, '--norm', 'none', '--minDist', MIN_DIST], [LOOPS]),
    'oe': ('over the expected', ['--pairs', LOOPS, '--norm', 'oe', '--minDist', MIN_DIST],
           [LOOPS, '--expected', EXPECTED_MOUSE]),
    'raw-every': ('raw, every loop', ['--pairs', LOOPS, '--norm', 'none', '--minDist', 0], [LOOPS, '--mindist', 0]),
    'oe-every': ('over the expected, every loop', ['--pairs', LOOPS, '--norm', 'oe', '--minDist', 0],
                 [LOOPS, '--expected', EXPECTED_MOUSE, '--mindist', 0]),
    'local': ('on the diagonal, raw', ['--anchors', 'features', '--features', ANCHORS, '--norm', 'none'],
              [ANCHORS, '--local']),
    'local-oe': ('on the diagonal, over the expected',
                 ['--anchors', 'features', '--features', ANCHORS, '--norm', 'oe'],
                 [ANCHORS, '--local', '--expected', EXPECTED_MOUSE]),
}
for key, (label, app_args, (features_, *options)) in CUTS.items():
    # Timed raw and over controls, not over the expected: there coolpuppy is handed § 4's expected,
    # computed beforehand, and chromosomix computes its own, so the two times are not of one job.
    timed = 'oe' not in key.split('-')
    mr('apa', MOUSE_10K, *app_args, '--mode', 'fixed', '--window', FLANK, '--minDiag', MIN_DIAG,
       out=APA / key, name=f'apa-{key}', analysis='Aggregate peak analysis', label=label, bench=timed)
    reference(f'coolpuppy-{key}', 'Aggregate peak analysis', 'coolpuppy',
              [PYTHON, PILEUP, MOUSE_10K, features_, FLANK * clr10.binsize, OUT, THREADS, *options],
              out=APA / f'coolpuppy-{key}.tsv', label=label, threads=THREADS, bench=timed)
SHIFTS = range(5)
for seed in SHIFTS:
    mr('apa', MOUSE_10K, '--pairs', LOOPS, '--norm', 'matched', '--controls', 5, '--minShift', 50,
       '--maxShift', 500, '--seed', seed + 1, '--mode', 'fixed', '--window', FLANK, '--minDiag', MIN_DIAG,
       '--minDist', MIN_DIST, out=APA / f'controls-seed{seed + 1}',
       name=f'apa-controls-seed{seed + 1}', analysis='Aggregate peak analysis', label=f'controls, seed {seed + 1}',
       group='controls', bench=seed == 0)
    reference(f'coolpuppy-controls-seed{seed}', 'Aggregate peak analysis', 'coolpuppy',
              [PYTHON, PILEUP, MOUSE_10K, LOOPS, FLANK * clr10.binsize, OUT, THREADS, '--nshifts', 5,
               '--minshift', 50 * clr10.binsize, '--maxshift', 500 * clr10.binsize + clr10.binsize // 2,
               '--seed', seed],
              out=APA / f'coolpuppy-controls-seed{seed}.tsv', label=f'controls, seed {seed}', group='controls',
              threads=THREADS, bench=seed == 0)


def pileup_of(folder, pattern='*.apa-0.tsv'):
    """A pileup chromosomix wrote, without its row and column names."""
    written_ = table(one(folder, pattern))
    return written_.set_index(written_.columns[0]).to_numpy(float)


def p2ll(pileup):
    """The app's P2LL: the mean of the centre over that of the lower-left corner, each a fifth of the window."""
    quadrant = max(1, min(pileup.shape) // 5)
    half, centre = quadrant // 2, pileup.shape[0] // 2
    return (np.nanmean(pileup[centre - half:centre + half + 1, centre - half:centre + half + 1])
            / np.nanmean(pileup[-quadrant:, :quadrant]))


cut_app = {k: pileup_of(APA / k) for k in CUTS}
cut_ref = {k: np.loadtxt(APA / f'coolpuppy-{k}.tsv') for k in CUTS}
same_gaps = {k: bool((np.isnan(cut_app[k]) == np.isnan(cut_ref[k])).all()) for k in CUTS}
cut_rel = {k: relative_difference(cut_app[k], cut_ref[k])[np.isfinite(cut_ref[k])] for k in CUTS}
controls_app = np.stack([pileup_of(APA / f'controls-seed{s + 1}') for s in SHIFTS])
controls_ref = np.stack([np.loadtxt(APA / f'coolpuppy-controls-seed{s}.tsv') for s in SHIFTS])
kept = np.isfinite(controls_ref[0])
welch = stats.ttest_ind(controls_app[:, kept], controls_ref[:, kept], axis=0, equal_var=False).pvalue


def gaps(left, right=None):
    """The largest cell difference between two runs, for every pair of runs: one of each stack, or
    any two of one stack."""
    pairs = product(left, right) if right is not None else combinations(left, 2)
    return np.array([np.nanmax(np.abs(a - b)) for a, b in pairs])


# A typical pair of runs, so that a pair of the two tools and a pair of one tool are read alike.
gap_cross, gap_ref, gap_app = (np.median(g) for g in (gaps(controls_app, controls_ref), gaps(controls_ref),
                                                     gaps(controls_app)))
# Cells at p < 0.01 by chance alone: what a binomial gives as often as one time in twenty.
by_chance = stats.binom.sf(int((welch < 0.01).sum()) - 1, welch.size, 0.01) > 0.05
centre = FLANK
measures({
    'loops called; nearer than coolpuppy\'s floor (windows reaching the first two diagonals); anchors':
        f"{len(called):,}; {reaching:,}; {len(anchors):,}",
    'with every loop, the loops the lower-left corner cell is a mean of, in both tools': f'{cornered:,}',
    **{f'{CUTS[k][0]}: max relative difference; cells left as gaps, chromosomix / coolpuppy':
       f'{cut_rel[k].max():.1e}; {int(np.isnan(cut_app[k]).sum())} / {int(np.isnan(cut_ref[k]).sum())}'
       for k in CUTS},
    'over controls, the centre: chromosomix seeds / coolpuppy seeds':
        f"{controls_app[:, centre, centre].min():.3f}–{controls_app[:, centre, centre].max():.3f} / "
        f"{controls_ref[:, centre, centre].min():.3f}–{controls_ref[:, centre, centre].max():.3f}",
    'over controls, P2LL: chromosomix seeds / coolpuppy seeds':
        f"{min(map(p2ll, controls_app)):.3f}–{max(map(p2ll, controls_app)):.3f} / "
        f"{min(map(p2ll, controls_ref)):.3f}–{max(map(p2ll, controls_ref)):.3f}",
    'over controls, a typical pair of runs\' largest cell difference: chromosomix vs coolpuppy; '
    'two of coolpuppy; two of chromosomix': f'{gap_cross:.3f}; {gap_ref:.3f}; {gap_app:.3f}',
    'over controls, cells whose five seeds differ (Welch, p < 0.01)': f'{int((welch < 0.01).sum())} of {welch.size}',
})
```

```{python}

#| fig-cap: "Pileups at chromosight's loops, mouse Hi-C at 10 kb, ±50 kb. a, every loop over the expected, as chromosomix draws it with `--minDist 0`; the cells towards the lower left are means of fewer loops, those whose windows stay clear of the diagonal there; b, every cell of the six pileups against coolpuppy's, raw and over the expected (O/E); c, over shifted controls at coolpuppy's defaults, the centre and P2LL of each tool's five seeds."
TEXT['apa_loops'] = f'{len(called):,}'

TEXT['apa_anchors'] = f'{len(anchors):,}'
TEXT['apa_cornered'] = f'{cornered:,}'

APA_GAPS = all(same_gaps.values())
TEXT['apa_gaps'] = 'the same cells left as gaps' if APA_GAPS else 'different cells left as gaps'
TEXT['apa_cross'] = f'{gap_cross:.3f}'

TEXT['apa_self_app'] = f'{gap_app:.3f}'

                      else f'more than chance gives ({0.01 * welch.size:.1f} expected)')

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(12, 3.9), layout='constrained', width_ratios=[1, 1, 1.1])
grey = plt.get_cmap('RdBu_r').copy()
grey.set_bad(MISSING)
bar = square(axes[0], cut_app['oe-every'], 'a  every loop, over the expected', cmap=grey, norm=LogNorm(1 / 3, 3),
             label='observed / expected')
bar.set_ticks([1 / 3, 1 / 2, 1, 2, 3], labels=['⅓', '½', '1', '2', '3'])
bar.minorticks_off()
ax = axes[1]
for k, key in enumerate(CUTS):
    values = np.maximum(cut_rel[key], 1e-9)
    ax.scatter(k + np.linspace(-0.25, 0.25, values.size), values, s=6, color=APP_COLOUR, lw=0)
ax.set(yscale='log', ylim=(1e-9, 1e-3), ylabel='|chromosomix / coolpuppy − 1|',
       title='b  every cell, six pileups')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(CUTS)), ['raw', 'O/E', 'raw,\nevery\nloop', 'O/E,\nevery\nloop', 'diagonal,\nraw',
                                  'diagonal,\nO/E'], fontsize=8)
ax = axes[2]
for k, (name, stack, colour) in enumerate((('chromosomix', controls_app, APP_COLOUR), ('coolpuppy', controls_ref, REF))):
    ax.scatter(np.full(len(stack), 0 + (k - 0.5) * 0.25), stack[:, centre, centre], s=30, color=colour, label=name, zorder=3)
    ax.scatter(np.full(len(stack), 1 + (k - 0.5) * 0.25), [p2ll(p) for p in stack], s=30, color=colour, zorder=3)
```

Raw and over the expected, at coolpuppy's defaults and with every loop, and on the diagonal both

## 12 · APA, chromosight's score

chromosight's own reading of a loop set: the map detrended by its distance law, a 17-bin window about
each loop, correlated with the loop template for a score, and averaged into a pileup. `apa --norm
chromosight` is chromosight's quantification, ported (§18.9); the reference is `chromosight quantify`
on the same map and the same loops, its pileup chromosight's own `pileup_patterns` of the windows it
writes.

```{python}
CSQ = WORK / 'chromosight-quantify'
mr('apa', MOUSE_10K, '--pairs', LOOPS, '--norm', 'chromosight', out=CSQ / 'app', name='apa-chromosight',
   analysis="APA, chromosight's score")
reference('chromosight-quantify', "APA, chromosight's score", 'chromosight',
          [CHROMOSIGHT, 'quantify', '--pattern', 'loops', '--threads', THREADS, LOOPS, MOUSE_10K, OUT],
          out=CSQ / 'quantify', made=CSQ / 'quantify.tsv', threads=THREADS)

import chromosight.utils.detection as chromosight_detection

quantified = pd.read_csv(CSQ / 'quantify.tsv', sep='\t')
scored = table(one(CSQ / 'app', '*.apa-chromosight-anchors.tsv'))
locus = scored['anchor'].str.rsplit(':', n=1)
scored['chrom1'], scored['start1'] = locus.str[0], locus.str[1].str.replace(',', '').astype(int) - 1
scored['start2'] = scored['start1'] + scored['separation']
m = quantified.merge(scored, on=['chrom1', 'start1', 'start2'], how='outer', indicator=True, suffixes=('_ref', '_app'))
paired = m[m['_merge'] == 'both']
finite = np.isfinite(paired['score_ref']) & np.isfinite(paired['score_app'])
windows = json.loads((CSQ / 'quantify.json').read_text())
cs_ref = chromosight_detection.pileup_patterns(np.stack([np.asarray(windows[k], float) for k in sorted(windows, key=int)]))
cs_app = pileup_of(CSQ / 'app', '*.apa-chromosight.tsv')
cs_score = np.abs(paired['score_ref'][finite] - paired['score_app'][finite]).max()
cs_pileup = relative_difference(cs_app, cs_ref).max()
measures({
    'loops, chromosomix / chromosight; the same; in one only':
        f"{len(scored):,} / {len(quantified):,}; {len(paired):,}; {int((m['_merge'] != 'both').sum())}",
    'scored by both; scored by one only': f"{int(finite.sum()):,}; {int((np.isfinite(paired['score_ref']) != np.isfinite(paired['score_app'])).sum())}",
    'score, max |difference| (four decimals written)': f'{cs_score:.1e}',
    'pileup, max relative difference': f'{cs_pileup:.1e}',
})
```

```{python}
TEXT['csq_score'] = f'{cs_score:.1e}'
```
