## 13 · Boost-HiC

Boost-HiC (Carron et al. 2019) reads a contact map as a graph whose edges are contacts turned into
distances, `1/cᵅ`, and replaces each by the shortest path between its ends: a contact the library was
too shallow to see is inferred from the ones around it. It is what an oversample draws a chromosome's
new contacts from (§6.5: `--contacts` above a map's own total), and `chromosomix boost` writes that map
as Boost-HiC's `main.py` writes its own — the bins its outlier filter keeps, and the boosted map over
them in SCN units. Boost-HiC itself is run as `main.py` runs it, through its own `HiCutils`, on the same
chromosome's raw counts. Three chromosomes at 100 kb, the smallest, one between and the largest:
Floyd–Warshall is cubic in the bins.

| | chromosomix | Boost-HiC |
|---|---|---|
| α | 0.2, the default | 0.2, `main.py`'s |
| outliers | a kernel density of the coverage, 5 % and 99.5 %, bandwidth 2,000 | `get_outliers` |
| boost | ten rounds of SCN, Floyd–Warshall on `1/SCNᵅ`, the decay put back | `SCN`, `fastFloyd`, `adjustPdS` |

```{python}
BH = WORK / 'boost-hic'
BOOSTED = {chrom: int(np.diff(clr100.extent(chrom))[0]) for chrom in ('chr19', 'chr11', 'chr1')}
for chrom, n in BOOSTED.items():
    label = f'{chrom}, {n:,} bins'
    # Timed on chr1 alone, the largest: the other two are the same computation on fewer bins.
    mr('boost', MOUSE_100K, '--sequences', chrom, out=BH / chrom, name=f'boost-{chrom}', analysis='Boost-HiC',
       label=label, bench=chrom == 'chr1')
    reference(f'boosthic-{chrom}', 'Boost-HiC', 'Boost-HiC', [PYTHON, script('boosthic'), MOUSE_100K, chrom, OUT],
              out=BH / f'boosthic-{chrom}', made=BH / f'boosthic-{chrom}-boosted.npy', env=BOOSTHIC_ENV, label=label,
              bench=chrom == 'chr1')

boosted, rows = {}, []
for chrom, n in BOOSTED.items():
    square_ = table(one(BH / chrom, f'*.boost-{chrom}.tsv'))
    app = square_.iloc[:, 1:].to_numpy(float)
    kept_app = (square_.iloc[:, 0].to_numpy() // clr100.binsize).astype(int)
    kept_ref = np.load(BH / f'boosthic-{chrom}-kept.npy')
    ref = np.load(BH / f'boosthic-{chrom}-boosted.npy')
    same = np.array_equal(kept_app, kept_ref)
    boosted[chrom] = dict(app=app, ref=ref, kept=kept_ref, same=same)
    rows.append({'chromosome': chrom, 'bins': n, 'kept, chromosomix / Boost-HiC': f'{len(kept_app):,} / {len(kept_ref):,}',
                 'the same bins': 'yes' if same else 'no',
                 'cells': app.size if same else np.nan,
                 'max relative difference': relative_difference(app, ref).max() if same else np.nan})
boost_table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
show(boost_table, **{'max relative difference': '{:.1e}', 'cells': '{:,.0f}', 'bins': '{:,}'})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-boost
#| fig-cap: "Boost-HiC at 100 kb. a, chr19's raw counts over the bins Boost-HiC keeps; b, the boosted map chromosomix writes, in SCN units; c, every cell of the three chromosomes, chromosomix against Boost-HiC."
BOOST_SAME = boost_table['the same bins'].eq('yes').all()
TEXT['bh_cells'] = f"{int(boost_table['cells'].sum()):,}"
TEXT['bh_max'] = f"{boost_table['max relative difference'].max():.1e}"
TEXT['bh_kept'] = ('Both keep the same bins on every chromosome' if BOOST_SAME
                   else 'The two keep different bins on ' + ', '.join(boost_table.loc[boost_table['the same bins'] == 'no', 'chromosome']))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(12, 3.9), layout='constrained')
v = boosted['chr19']
counts = np.asarray(clr100.matrix(balance=False).fetch('chr19'), float)[np.ix_(v['kept'], v['kept'])]
square(axes[0], np.where(counts > 0, counts, np.nan), 'a  chr19, raw', norm=LogNorm(), label='contacts')
square(axes[1], v['app'], 'b  chr19, boosted (chromosomix)', norm=LogNorm(), label='SCN units')
agreement(axes[2], np.concatenate([b['ref'].ravel() for b in boosted.values()]),
          np.concatenate([b['app'].ravel() for b in boosted.values()]), 'Boost-HiC', 'chromosomix',
          'c  every cell', scale='log')
plt.show()
```

`{python} TEXT['bh_kept']`, and over the `{python} TEXT['bh_cells']` cells of the chromosomes where they
are the same the boosted maps agree within `{python} TEXT['bh_max']`, the ten digits
`chromosomix boost` writes.

```{python}
       f"the same bins kept; {TEXT['bh_cells']} cells within {TEXT['bh_max']}",
       'Identical' if BOOST_SAME else 'Differs', apps=[f'boost-{c}' for c in BOOSTED],
```

## 14 · Metaplot (deepTools)

The mean of a track about a set of features: replicate 1 of the mouse ATAC-seq, the whole genome,
about the TSS of every RefSeq transcript, ±2 kb in 50 bp bins, a minus-strand window read backwards.
deepTools' `computeMatrix reference-point` reads every base of a window (`pyBigWig.values`) and
averages the ones the track covers bin by bin, as the app does; deepTools' profile is `plotProfile`'s,
each bin's mean over the transcripts with a value there. The app ranks its rows, one per transcript,
by their mean and deepTools keeps the BED's order, so rows are paired by that ranking, rows of the
same mean in whichever order matches.

| | chromosomix | deepTools |
|---|---|---|
| anchor | `--mode reference --at start`, stranded (the default) | `reference-point --referencePoint TSS` |
| window | `--flank 2000 --step 50` | `-b 2000 -a 2000 --binSize 50` |
| average | the mean (the default), no band (`--band none`) | `--averageTypeBins mean`; `plotProfile` |

```{python}
MP = WORK / 'metaplot'
MP.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
signal = pyBigWig.open(str(ATAC[0]))
covered = signal.chroms()
signal.close()
TSS_BED = MP / 'transcripts.bed'
TRANSCRIPTS[TRANSCRIPTS['chrom'].isin(covered)][BED6].to_csv(TSS_BED, sep='\t', header=False, index=False)
mr('metaplot', '--tracks', ATAC[0], '--features', TSS_BED, '--mode', 'reference', '--at', 'start', '--flank', 2000,
   '--step', 50, '--band', 'none', out=MP / 'app', name='metaplot', analysis='Metaplot', group='TSS')
reference('computematrix', 'Metaplot', 'deepTools',
          [COMPUTEMATRIX, 'reference-point', '-S', ATAC[0], '-R', TSS_BED, '--referencePoint', 'TSS', '-b', 2000,
           '-a', 2000, '--binSize', 50, '-p', THREADS, '-o', OUT],
          out=MP / 'deeptools.mat.gz', label='computeMatrix', group='TSS', threads=THREADS)
reference('plotprofile', 'Metaplot', 'deepTools',
          [PLOTPROFILE, '-m', MP / 'deeptools.mat.gz', '-out', f'{OUT}.png', '--outFileNameData', f'{OUT}.tab'],
          out=MP / 'deeptools-profile', made=MP / 'deeptools-profile.tab', label='plotProfile', group='TSS')

profile_app = table(one(MP / 'app', '*.metaplot.tsv'))
profile_ref = pd.read_csv(MP / 'deeptools-profile.tab', sep='\t', header=None, skiprows=2).iloc[0, 2:].to_numpy(float)
offsets = profile_app.iloc[:, 0].to_numpy(float)
profile_app = profile_app.iloc[:, 1].to_numpy(float)
rows_app = table(one(MP / 'app', '*.metaplot-heatmap.tsv')).iloc[:, 1:].to_numpy(float)
rows_ref = pd.read_csv(MP / 'deeptools.mat.gz', sep='\t', header=None, skiprows=1).iloc[:, 6:].to_numpy(float)


def written(ref):
    """What two writers' rounding allows: the app's six significant digits, deepTools' six decimals."""
    return 5e-7 + 5e-6 * np.abs(ref)


def paired_rows(app, ref):
    """For each of the app's rows, strongest first, the deepTools row paired with it: of those whose mean
    is the same within the rounding, the unpaired one closest to it."""
    def strength(rows):
        with np.errstate(invalid='ignore'):
            means = np.nanmean(rows, axis=1)
        return np.where(np.isnan(means), -np.inf, means)
    mine, theirs = strength(app), strength(ref)
    order = np.argsort(theirs, kind='stable')
    sorted_ = theirs[order]
    used, match = np.zeros(len(ref), bool), np.empty(len(app), int)
    for i, row in enumerate(app):
        slack = 1e-5 * abs(mine[i]) + 1e-6 if np.isfinite(mine[i]) else 0
        lo, hi = np.searchsorted(sorted_, mine[i] - slack, 'left'), np.searchsorted(sorted_, mine[i] + slack, 'right')
        candidates = order[lo:hi][~used[order[lo:hi]]]
        if len(candidates) == 0:
            candidates = np.flatnonzero(~used)
        pick = candidates[int(np.argmin(past(row, ref[candidates]).max(axis=1)))]
        used[pick], match[i] = True, pick
    return match


def past(app, ref):
    """How far each cell is past the two writers' rounding (≤ 0: within it); two gaps are within it."""
    excess = np.abs(app - ref) - written(ref)
    excess = np.where(np.isnan(app) & np.isnan(ref), -1.0, excess)
    return np.where(np.isnan(excess), np.inf, excess)


match = cached(MP / 'paired.npy', lambda: paired_rows(rows_app, rows_ref)).astype(int)
row_excess = past(rows_app, rows_ref[match])
profile_rel = relative_difference(profile_app, profile_ref).max()
measures({
    'transcripts, chromosomix / deepTools': f'{len(rows_app):,} / {len(rows_ref):,}',
    'profile, max relative difference': f'{profile_rel:.1e}',
    'rows paired one to one': 'every one' if len(set(match)) == len(match) == len(rows_ref) else 'not every one',
    'cells past both tools\' rounding': f'{int((row_excess > 0).sum()):,} of {row_excess.size:,}',
})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-metaplot
#| fig-cap: "ATAC-seq about RefSeq TSS. a, the profile; b, chromosomix's rows, strongest first; c, every cell of every row against deepTools' row paired with it."
TEXT['mp_n'] = f'{len(rows_app):,}'
TEXT['mp_profile'] = f'{profile_rel:.1e}'
TEXT['mp_cells'] = f'{int((row_excess > 0).sum()):,}'
METAPLOT_OK = int((row_excess > 0).sum()) == 0 and len(set(match)) == len(rows_ref)
TEXT['mp_rows'] = ('every one of the' if METAPLOT_OK else 'not every one of the')

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(12, 3.9), layout='constrained', width_ratios=[1.2, 0.8, 1])
ax = axes[0]
ax.plot(offsets, profile_ref, color=REF, lw=3, label='deepTools plotProfile')
ax.plot(offsets, profile_app, color=APP_COLOUR, lw=1.2, label='chromosomix')
ax.set(xlabel='from the TSS (bp)', ylabel='mean ATAC signal', title='a  profile')
ax.legend(loc='upper left')
ax = axes[1]
ax.imshow(rows_app, aspect='auto', cmap=DENSITY, norm=LogNorm(0.05, np.nanpercentile(rows_app, 99.5)),
          interpolation='nearest', extent=[offsets[0] - 25, offsets[-1] + 25, len(rows_app), 0])
ax.set(xlabel='from the TSS (bp)', ylabel='transcripts, strongest first', title='b  every transcript')
ax.grid(False)
agreement(axes[2], rows_ref[match].ravel(), rows_app.ravel(), 'deepTools computeMatrix', 'chromosomix',
          'c  every bin of every row', scale='log')
plt.show()
```

The profiles agree within `{python} TEXT['mp_profile']`, the six digits written, and
`{python} TEXT['mp_rows']` `{python} TEXT['mp_n']` rows has its pair with every bin within the two
tools' rounding (`{python} TEXT['mp_cells']` cells past it).

**Over two tracks** the app draws a heatmap for each, and lists the transcripts in one order in all of
them: by each one's mean over every bin of every track, strongest first. That is `plotHeatmap`'s order
for a matrix of several samples, whose defaults (`--sortRegions descend --sortUsing mean`) sort by the
mean over every sample. So both replicates at once, and the two tools' rows compared in that order: the
app's two heatmaps side by side against `computeMatrix`'s rows, in the order of the regions
`plotHeatmap` writes. A transcript neither track covers has no mean at all; the app puts it last and
deepTools first, its descending order being NumPy's ascending one reversed, and those are compared apart.

| | chromosomix | deepTools |
|---|---|---|
| tracks | `--tracks`, once for each replicate | `computeMatrix reference-point -S`, both replicates |
| order | the heatmaps' own | `plotHeatmap --outFileSortedRegions` |

```{python}
mr('metaplot', '--tracks', ATAC[0], '--tracks', ATAC[1], '--features', TSS_BED, '--mode', 'reference', '--at',
   'start', '--flank', 2000, '--step', 50, '--band', 'none', out=MP / 'app-two', name='metaplot-two',
   analysis='Metaplot', group='TSS, two tracks')
reference('computematrix-two', 'Metaplot', 'deepTools',
          [COMPUTEMATRIX, 'reference-point', '-S', ATAC[0], ATAC[1], '-R', TSS_BED, '--referencePoint', 'TSS',
           '-b', 2000, '-a', 2000, '--binSize', 50, '-p', THREADS, '-o', OUT],
          out=MP / 'deeptools-two.mat.gz', label='computeMatrix', group='TSS, two tracks', threads=THREADS)
reference('plotprofile-two', 'Metaplot', 'deepTools',
          [PLOTPROFILE, '-m', MP / 'deeptools-two.mat.gz', '-out', f'{OUT}.png', '--outFileNameData', f'{OUT}.tab'],
          out=MP / 'deeptools-two-profile', made=MP / 'deeptools-two-profile.tab', label='plotProfile',
          group='TSS, two tracks')
reference('plotheatmap-two', 'Metaplot', 'deepTools',
          [PLOTHEATMAP, '-m', MP / 'deeptools-two.mat.gz', '-out', f'{OUT}.png', '--outFileSortedRegions',
           f'{OUT}.bed'],
          out=MP / 'deeptools-two-heatmap', made=MP / 'deeptools-two-heatmap.bed', label='plotHeatmap',
          group='TSS, two tracks')

curves = table(one(MP / 'app-two', '*.metaplot.tsv'))
profiles_app = curves[[c for c in curves.columns[1:] if not c.endswith(('_low', '_high'))]].to_numpy(float).T
profiles_ref = pd.read_csv(MP / 'deeptools-two-profile.tab', sep='\t', header=None,
                           skiprows=2).iloc[:, 2:].to_numpy(float)
# The two heatmaps side by side, as computeMatrix writes two samples: a row's bins of the first, then the second's.
heatmaps = [table(one(MP / 'app-two', f'*.{name}.tsv')).iloc[:, 1:].to_numpy(float)
            for name in ('metaplot-heatmap', 'metaplot-heatmap-2')]
both_app = np.hstack(heatmaps)
regions = pd.read_csv(MP / 'deeptools-two.mat.gz', sep='\t', header=None, skiprows=1)
both_ref = regions.iloc[:, 6:].to_numpy(float)


def place(frame):
    """A region of a deepTools table by its coordinates, name and strand."""
    return frame[0].astype(str) + ':' + frame[1].astype(str) + '-' + frame[2].astype(str) + ' ' + frame[3] + frame[5]


# plotHeatmap's order: the regions it wrote, top to bottom, each found among computeMatrix's rows.
listed = pd.read_csv(MP / 'deeptools-two-heatmap.bed', sep='\t', header=None, comment='#')
order_ref = pd.Series(np.arange(len(regions)), index=place(regions))[place(listed)].to_numpy()
with np.errstate(invalid='ignore'):
    key_app, key_ref = np.nanmean(both_app, axis=1), np.nanmean(both_ref[order_ref], axis=1)
none_app, none_ref = np.isnan(key_app), np.isnan(key_ref)
uncovered = int(none_app.sum())
# Each tool's covered rows in its own order, held position by position to the other's: the app's uncovered
# rows are its last, deepTools' its first.
order_same = bool(none_ref.sum() == uncovered and none_app[len(none_app) - uncovered:].all()
                  and none_ref[:uncovered].all()
                  and (np.abs(key_app[~none_app] - key_ref[~none_ref]) <= written(key_ref[~none_ref])).all())
match_two = cached(MP / 'paired-two.npy', lambda: paired_rows(both_app, both_ref)).astype(int)
two_excess = past(both_app, both_ref[match_two])
profiles_rel = relative_difference(profiles_app, profiles_ref).max()
measures({
    'transcripts, chromosomix / deepTools': f'{len(both_app):,} / {len(both_ref):,}',
    'profiles, max relative difference': f'{profiles_rel:.1e}',
    'rows paired one to one': 'every one' if len(set(match_two)) == len(match_two) == len(both_ref) else 'not every one',
    'cells of both heatmaps past both tools\' rounding': f'{int((two_excess > 0).sum()):,} of {two_excess.size:,}',
    'order, against plotHeatmap\'s': 'the same' if order_same else 'not the same',
    'transcripts neither track covers': f'{uncovered:,}',
})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-metaplot-two
#| fig-cap: "Both replicates about RefSeq TSS. a, each one's profile; b and c, chromosomix's two heatmaps, one row per transcript and the same transcript on a row in both; d, each row's mean over both tracks, top to bottom, in chromosomix's order and in plotHeatmap's."
TEXT['mp2_profiles'] = f'{profiles_rel:.1e}'
TEXT['mp2_cells'] = f'{int((two_excess > 0).sum()):,}'
TEXT['mp2_uncovered'] = f'{uncovered:,}'
TEXT['mp2_order'] = 'in the same order' if order_same else 'not in the same order'
METAPLOT_TWO_OK = int((two_excess > 0).sum()) == 0 and len(set(match_two)) == len(both_ref) and order_same

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(12, 3.9), layout='constrained', width_ratios=[1.2, 0.6, 0.6, 1])
ax = axes[0]
for i, (mine, theirs) in enumerate(zip(profiles_app, profiles_ref)):
    ax.plot(offsets, theirs, color=REF, lw=3, label='deepTools plotProfile' if i == 0 else None)
    ax.plot(offsets, mine, color=APP_COLOUR, lw=1.2, label='chromosomix' if i == 0 else None)
ax.set(xlabel='from the TSS (bp)', ylabel='mean ATAC signal', title='a  profiles')
ax.legend(loc='upper left')
for ax, rows, title in zip(axes[1:3], heatmaps, ('b  replicate 1', 'c  replicate 2')):
    ax.imshow(rows, aspect='auto', cmap=DENSITY, norm=LogNorm(0.05, np.nanpercentile(rows, 99.5)),
              interpolation='nearest', extent=[offsets[0] - 25, offsets[-1] + 25, len(rows), 0])
    ax.set(xlabel='from the TSS (bp)', title=title)
    ax.grid(False)
axes[1].set_ylabel('transcripts, strongest over both first')
axes[2].set_yticks([])
ax = axes[3]
ax.plot(key_ref[~none_ref], color=REF, lw=3, label="plotHeatmap's order")
ax.plot(key_app[~none_app], color=APP_COLOUR, lw=1.2, label="chromosomix's")
ax.set(yscale='log', xlabel='row, top to bottom', ylabel='mean over both tracks', title='d  the order')
ax.legend(loc='upper right')
plt.show()
```

Both profiles agree within `{python} TEXT['mp2_profiles']`; every row of the two heatmaps has its pair
among `computeMatrix`'s, both tracks' bins within the two tools' rounding
(`{python} TEXT['mp2_cells']` cells past it); and the rows are `{python} TEXT['mp2_order']` as
`plotHeatmap`'s, each one's mean over both tracks within that rounding of the mean of the row
deepTools puts there, with the `{python} TEXT['mp2_uncovered']` transcripts neither replicate covers
at the other end.

```{python}
record('Metaplot', 'mouse ATAC-seq, one and two replicates, whole genome, RefSeq TSS ±2 kb',
       f"deepTools {VERSIONS['deeptools']}",
       f"profiles within {max(profile_rel, profiles_rel):.1e}; {TEXT['mp_n']} rows a track, paired one to one "
       "within the rounding; over two tracks, plotHeatmap's order",
       'Identical' if METAPLOT_OK and METAPLOT_TWO_OK else 'Differs', apps=['metaplot', 'metaplot-two'],
       refs=['computematrix', 'plotprofile', 'computematrix-two', 'plotprofile-two', 'plotheatmap-two'])
```

## 15 · Interval overlap (bedtools)

How much two interval sets share: in bases, with a Jaccard index over them, and in features, those of
each set that touch the other. Each tool merges a set's own overlaps first. The sets are the ATAC-seq
peaks of § 5, yapc's at IDR ≤ 0.05 on chr19, and the promoters on chr19, 1 kb either side of every
RefSeq TSS. Then the null the app sets an overlap against: the peaks moved at random, each within its
own chromosome and keeping its length, a thousand times — what `bedtools shuffle -chrom` does. Two
random draws, so the two nulls are compared as distributions.

| | chromosomix | bedtools |
|---|---|---|
| observed | `overlap --a peaks --b promoters` | `jaccard`; `intersect -u`, both ways |
| null | `--shuffle --iterations 1000` | `shuffle -chrom -seed 1…1000`, then the same |
| lengths | mm10's, from `--sequence` | mm10's, as a genome file |

```{python}
OV = WORK / 'overlap'
OV.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PEAKS_BED = SEEDS[0] / 'yapc_0.05.bed'
PROMOTERS = OV / 'promoters.bed'
GENOME = OV / 'mm10.genome'
promoters = TRANSCRIPTS.assign(start=np.maximum(0, TSS - 1000), end=TSS + 1000)
promoters[promoters['chrom'] == 'chr19'].sort_values(['start', 'end'])[BED6].to_csv(
    PROMOTERS, sep='\t', header=False, index=False)
pd.read_csv(f'{MM10}.fai', sep='\t', header=None, usecols=[0, 1]).to_csv(GENOME, sep='\t', header=False, index=False)
ITERATIONS = 1000
mr('overlap', '--sequence', MM10, '--features', PEAKS_BED, '--features', PROMOTERS, '--a', PEAKS_BED,
   '--b', PROMOTERS, '--shuffle', '--iterations', ITERATIONS, '--seed', 1, out=OV / 'app', name='overlap',
   analysis='Interval overlap')
reference('bedtools-overlap', 'Interval overlap', 'bedtools',
          [PYTHON, script('bedtools_overlap'), PEAKS_BED, PROMOTERS, GENOME, ITERATIONS, OUT],
          out=OV / 'bedtools', made=OV / 'bedtools-null.tsv')

said = table(one(OV / 'app', '*.overlap.tsv')).set_index('measure')
hit = lambda measure: int(re.match(r'([\d,]+) of', said.loc[measure, 'note']).group(1).replace(',', ''))
observed_app = {'intersection': int(said.loc['Shared bases', 'value']), 'union': int(said.loc['Bases in either', 'value']),
                'jaccard': float(said.loc['Jaccard (bases)', 'value']), 'a_hit': hit('First set hit'),
                'b_hit': hit('Second set hit')}
observed_ref = pd.read_csv(OV / 'bedtools-observed.tsv', sep='\t').iloc[0].to_dict()
null_app = table(one(OV / 'app', '*.overlap-null.tsv')).set_index('measure')
null_ref = pd.read_csv(OV / 'bedtools-null.tsv', sep='\t')
NULLS = {'Shared bases': 'intersection', 'Features of the first set hit': 'a_hit'}
rows = []
for measure, column in NULLS.items():
    mean_app = float(null_app.loc[measure, 'expected'])
    sd_app = (float(null_app.loc[measure, 'observed']) - mean_app) / float(null_app.loc[measure, 'z'])
    mean_ref, sd_ref = null_ref[column].mean(), null_ref[column].std()
    rows.append({'null of': measure, 'chromosomix, mean ± sd': f'{mean_app:,.1f} ± {sd_app:,.1f}',
                 'bedtools, mean ± sd': f'{mean_ref:,.1f} ± {sd_ref:,.1f}',
                 'difference of the means, in standard errors': (mean_app - mean_ref) / np.sqrt(
                     (sd_app ** 2 + sd_ref ** 2) / ITERATIONS),
                 'ratio of the sds': sd_app / sd_ref})
null_table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
display(measures({
    'peaks; promoters': f"{len(pd.read_csv(PEAKS_BED, sep='\t', header=None, comment='#')):,}; {sum(1 for _ in open(PROMOTERS)):,}",
    **{f'{k}, chromosomix / bedtools': f'{observed_app[k]:,} / {observed_ref[k]:,}' for k in ('intersection', 'union', 'a_hit', 'b_hit')},
    'Jaccard, chromosomix (four decimals) / bedtools': f"{observed_app['jaccard']} / {observed_ref['jaccard']}",
}))
show(null_table, precision=2)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-overlap
#| fig-cap: "The null of each tool for the bases peaks and promoters share on chr19 (a) and for the peaks on a promoter (b): bedtools' thousand shuffles, chromosomix's mean ± sd over its own thousand, and what is observed."
OBSERVED_SAME = all(observed_app[k] == int(observed_ref[k]) for k in ('intersection', 'union', 'a_hit', 'b_hit'))
NULL_SAME = ((null_table['difference of the means, in standard errors'].abs() < 3).all()
             and null_table['ratio of the sds'].between(0.9, 1.1).all())
TEXT['ov_shared'] = f"{observed_app['intersection']:,}"
TEXT['ov_count'] = 'count the same' if OBSERVED_SAME else 'do not count the same'
TEXT['ov_null'] = 'are one distribution' if NULL_SAME else 'differ'
TEXT['ov_union'] = f"{observed_app['union']:,}"
TEXT['ov_hit'] = f"{observed_app['a_hit']:,}"
TEXT['ov_z'] = f"{null_table['difference of the means, in standard errors'].abs().max():.1f}"
TEXT['ov_sd'] = ' to '.join(dict.fromkeys(f'{r:.2f}' for r in sorted(null_table['ratio of the sds'])))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 3.6), layout='constrained')
for ax, (letter, (measure, column)) in zip(axes, zip('ab', NULLS.items())):
    ax.hist(null_ref[column], bins=40, color=REF, alpha=0.7, label='bedtools, 1,000 shuffles')
    mean_app = float(null_app.loc[measure, 'expected'])
    sd_app = (float(null_app.loc[measure, 'observed']) - mean_app) / float(null_app.loc[measure, 'z'])
    ax.axvspan(mean_app - sd_app, mean_app + sd_app, color=APP_COLOUR, alpha=0.15, lw=0)
    ax.axvline(mean_app, color=APP_COLOUR, lw=2, label='chromosomix, mean ± sd')
    ax.axvline(observed_app[column], color=INK, lw=1.2, ls=(0, (4, 3)), label='observed')
    ax.set(xlabel=measure.lower(), ylabel='shuffles', title=f'{letter}  {measure.lower()}')
axes[0].legend(loc='upper center')
plt.show()
```

The two tools `{python} TEXT['ov_count']`: `{python} TEXT['ov_shared']` bases shared of
`{python} TEXT['ov_union']`, and `{python} TEXT['ov_hit']` peaks on a promoter, by the app's count.
Their nulls `{python} TEXT['ov_null']`: the means differ by at most `{python} TEXT['ov_z']` standard
errors and the spreads are in a ratio of `{python} TEXT['ov_sd']`.

```{python}
record('Interval overlap', 'ATAC-seq peaks (§ 5) and promoters, chr19', f"bedtools {PROGRAMS['bedtools']}",
       f"the same bases and features counted; the nulls' means within {TEXT['ov_z']} standard errors",
       ('Identical' if OBSERVED_SAME else 'Differs') + ('; the same null' if NULL_SAME else '; nulls differ'),
       apps=['overlap'], refs=['bedtools-overlap'])
```

## 16 · Base composition

GC content and GC skew in 10 kb bins along mm10: `chromosomix composition` against bioframe's
`frac_gc`, G and C over the bases that are not N, and Biopython's `GC_skew`, (G − C)/(G + C). Biopython
writes 0 for a bin with neither G nor C, where the app writes no value.

```{python}
COMP = WORK / 'composition'
mr('composition', '--sequence', MM10, '--resolution', 10_000, out=COMP / 'app', name='composition',
   analysis='Base composition')
reference('composition', 'Base composition', 'bioframe, Biopython',
          [PYTHON, script('composition'), MM10, 10_000, OUT], out=COMP / 'reference.tsv')

composition = pd.read_csv(COMP / 'reference.tsv', sep='\t')
for track, column in (('gc', 'gc_app'), ('gcskew', 'skew_app')):
    written_ = pd.read_csv(one(COMP / 'app', f'*.composition-{track}.bedGraph'), sep='\t', comment='#', header=None,
                           names=['chrom', 'start', 'end', column])
    composition = composition.merge(written_[['chrom', 'start', column]], on=['chrom', 'start'], how='left')
gc_app, gc_ref = composition['gc_app'].to_numpy(float), composition['GC'].to_numpy(float)
skew_app, skew_ref = composition['skew_app'].to_numpy(float), composition['skew'].to_numpy(float)
gc_both = np.isfinite(gc_app) & np.isfinite(gc_ref)
skew_both = np.isfinite(skew_app) & np.isfinite(skew_ref)
unread = ~np.isfinite(skew_app) & np.isfinite(skew_ref)
measures({
    'bins': f'{len(composition):,}',
    'GC: bins both read; max |difference|': f'{gc_both.sum():,}; {np.abs(gc_app - gc_ref)[gc_both].max():.1e}',
    'GC: bins neither reads (all N); read by one only':
        f"{int((~np.isfinite(gc_app) & ~np.isfinite(gc_ref)).sum()):,}; {int((np.isfinite(gc_app) != np.isfinite(gc_ref)).sum())}",
    'GC skew: bins both read; max |difference|': f'{skew_both.sum():,}; {np.abs(skew_app - skew_ref)[skew_both].max():.1e}',
    'GC skew: bins only Biopython writes, and its value there': f"{int(unread.sum()):,}, {', '.join(f'{v:g}' for v in np.unique(skew_ref[unread]))}",
})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-composition
#| fig-cap: "Composition of mm10 in 10 kb bins. a, GC content; b, GC skew; c, GC content along chr11, 30–40 Mb."
TEXT['comp_n'] = f'{gc_both.sum():,}'
TEXT['comp_gc'] = f'{np.abs(gc_app - gc_ref)[gc_both].max():.1e}'
TEXT['comp_skew'] = f'{np.abs(skew_app - skew_ref)[skew_both].max():.1e}'
TEXT['comp_unread'] = f'{int(unread.sum()):,}'
COMP_OK = (np.isfinite(gc_app) == np.isfinite(gc_ref)).all() and (skew_ref[unread] == 0).all()

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(11, 7.2), layout='constrained')
grid = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1.15, 1])
agreement(fig.add_subplot(grid[0, 0]), gc_ref, gc_app, 'bioframe frac_gc', 'chromosomix', 'a  GC content')
agreement(fig.add_subplot(grid[0, 1]), skew_ref[skew_both], skew_app[skew_both], 'Biopython GC_skew', 'chromosomix',
          'b  GC skew')
ax = fig.add_subplot(grid[1, :])
along = composition[(composition['chrom'] == 'chr11') & composition['start'].between(30e6, 40e6 - 1)]
ax.plot(along['start'] / 1e6, along['GC'], color=REF, lw=3, label='bioframe')
ax.plot(along['start'] / 1e6, along['gc_app'], color=APP_COLOUR, lw=1.2, label='chromosomix')
ax.set(xlabel='chr11 (Mb)', ylabel='GC content', title='c  chr11, 30–40 Mb')
ax.legend(loc='upper left', ncols=2)

```

Over the `{python} TEXT['comp_n']` bins with sequence in them the GC content agrees within

## 17 · Motif search (seqkit)

Every place a motif occurs on chr19, on both strands, overlapping sites included: the AP-1 site
`TGACTCA` allowing one mismatch, and the GATA site `WGATAR`, in IUPAC codes, exactly. Both are given
chr19 alone as a FASTA. `seqkit locate` reports a site that reads the same on both strands twice, one
per strand, where the app reports it once, as `.`: those are counted on both strands.

| | chromosomix | seqkit |
|---|---|---|
| strands | both (the default) | both (the default) |
| mismatches | `--mismatches 1` | `-m 1` |
| IUPAC codes | always | `-d` |
| case | ignored | `-i` |

```{python}
MOTIF = WORK / 'motif'
CHR19_FA = DATA / 'mm10.chr19.fa'
if REDO or not CHR19_FA.exists():
    CHR19_FA.write_text(f">chr19\n{str(pyfaidx.Fasta(str(MM10))['chr19'][:])}\n")
MOTIFS = {'TGACTCA': 1, 'WGATAR': 0}
for pattern, mismatches in MOTIFS.items():
    label = f'{pattern}, ≤ {mismatches} mismatch' if mismatches else pattern
    mr('motif', '--sequence', CHR19_FA, '--pattern', pattern, '--mismatches', mismatches, out=MOTIF / pattern,
       name=f'motif-{pattern}', analysis='Motif search', label=label)
    reference(f'seqkit-{pattern}', 'Motif search', 'seqkit',
              [SEQKIT, 'locate', '-i', *(['-m', mismatches] if mismatches else ['-d']), '-p', pattern, '--bed',
               '-j', THREADS, CHR19_FA, '-o', OUT],
              out=MOTIF / f'seqkit-{pattern}.bed', label=label, threads=THREADS)

SITE = ['chrom', 'start', 'end', 'strand']
found, rows = {}, []
for pattern in MOTIFS:
    app = pd.read_csv(one(MOTIF / pattern, '*.bed'), sep='\t', comment='#', header=None,
                      names=['chrom', 'start', 'end', 'name', 'score', 'strand'])
    app = pd.concat([app[app['strand'] != '.'], *[app[app['strand'] == '.'].assign(strand=s) for s in '+-']])
    ref = pd.read_csv(MOTIF / f'seqkit-{pattern}.bed', sep='\t', header=None,
                      names=['chrom', 'start', 'end', 'name', 'score', 'strand'])
    m = app[SITE].merge(ref[SITE], how='outer', indicator=True)
    found[pattern] = dict(app=app, ref=ref)
    rows.append({'motif': pattern, 'sites, chromosomix / seqkit': f'{len(app):,} / {len(ref):,}',
                 'the same site and strand': int((m['_merge'] == 'both').sum()),
                 'in one only': int((m['_merge'] != 'both').sum())})
motif_table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
show(motif_table, **{'the same site and strand': '{:,}'})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-motif
#| fig-cap: "Sites per megabase along chr19, each motif, both strands."
MOTIF_OK = motif_table['in one only'].eq(0).all()
TEXT['motif_sites'] = ' and '.join(f"{n:,}" for n in motif_table['the same site and strand'])
TEXT['motif_only'] = ('and none in one only' if MOTIF_OK
                      else f"and {motif_table['in one only'].sum():,} in one only")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 3.4), layout='constrained')
edges = np.arange(0, 62e6, 1e6)
for ax, (letter, (pattern, v)) in zip(axes, zip('ab', found.items())):
    ax.stairs(np.histogram(v['ref']['start'], edges)[0], edges / 1e6, color=REF, lw=3, label='seqkit')
    ax.stairs(np.histogram(v['app']['start'], edges)[0], edges / 1e6, color=APP_COLOUR, lw=1.2, label='chromosomix')
    ax.set(xlabel='chr19 (Mb)', ylabel='sites per Mb', title=f'{letter}  {pattern}')
axes[0].legend(loc='lower center', ncols=2)
plt.show()
```

The two find the same `{python} TEXT['motif_sites']` sites, each on the same strand,
`{python} TEXT['motif_only']`.

```{python}
record('Motif search', 'mm10 chr19, two motifs, both strands', f"seqkit {PROGRAMS['seqkit']}",
       f"the same {TEXT['motif_sites']} sites", 'Identical' if MOTIF_OK else 'Differs',
       apps=[f'motif-{p}' for p in MOTIFS], refs=[f'seqkit-{p}' for p in MOTIFS])
```

## 18 · Track correlation (deepTools)

How much every pair of three public mouse tracks agrees, over whole windows of 100 bp, 1 kb and
10 kb, by Pearson's r and by Spearman's ρ: the two ATAC-seq replicates of § 5, and the diamond
insulation score 4DN computed from mouse ES-cell Hi-C (Bonev et al. 2017), one value every 5 kb and
none where the map is too sparse to give one. All three are 4DN's, on mm10, and every tool is given
them cut to chr19, interval for interval, as § 5 cuts them. Genome-wide, the two replicates are
1.7 GB of bigWig, and one deepTools summary of them at 100 bp — 27 million windows — took 23 minutes
and 4.8 GB here and wrote 1.5 GB of text: a cost the timings would pay at three window sizes, five
times over. A window's value is the mean over the bases a track has a value for, and a window any
of the three lacks — here, where the insulation score has no value — is left out of every pair, as
deepTools leaves it out. The reference for exactly that is pyBigWig's own exact mean,
`stats(..., exact=True)`, correlated by SciPy over the windows every track has
(`notebooks/scripts/pybigwig_correlation.py`). Beside it is deepTools as it is usually run,
`multiBigwigSummary bins` then `plotCorrelation`, which differs in one way, measured below: its
window means are pyBigWig's default, read from a zoom level wherever the file has one fine enough.

| | chromosomix | pyBigWig and SciPy | deepTools |
|---|---|---|---|
| windows | `--binsize B`, whole windows | whole windows of B | `multiBigwigSummary bins --binSize B` |
| a window's value | the mean over the bases with a value | `stats(..., exact=True)` | `stats(...)`, from a zoom level where one is fine enough |
| a missing window | left out of every pair | left out of every pair | left out of every pair |
| correlation | `--method pearson`, `spearman` | `scipy.stats.pearsonr`, `spearmanr` | `plotCorrelation -c pearson`, `spearman` |

```{python}
TC = WORK / 'trackcorr'
# § 5's two replicates as § 5 cut them, and the insulation score cut by the same hand.
INSULATION = DATA / f"{PATHS['4DNFIUJ5CJVN'].stem}.chr19.bw"
chr19(PATHS['4DNFIUJ5CJVN'], INSULATION)
TRACKS = [*REPS, INSULATION]
TRACK_NAMES = [path.name for path in TRACKS]
SHORT = dict(zip(TRACK_NAMES, ('ATAC, rep. 1', 'ATAC, rep. 2', 'insulation')))
SIZES, METHODS = (100, 1_000, 10_000), ('pearson', 'spearman')
CORR = script('pybigwig_correlation')
for size in SIZES:
    # Both methods of each tool in one group: chromosomix answers one per run, deepTools both from
    # one summary of the windows.
    group = f'{size:,} bp windows'
    for method in METHODS:
        mr('trackcorr', '--tracks', ','.join(rel(path) for path in TRACKS), '--binsize', size,
           '--method', method, out=TC / f'app-{size}-{method}', name=f'trackcorr-{size}-{method}',
           analysis='Track correlation', label=f'{size:,} bp, {method}', group=group)
        reference(f'pybigwig-correlation-{size}-{method}', 'Track correlation', 'pyBigWig, SciPy',
                  [PYTHON, CORR, OUT, size, method, *TRACKS], out=TC / f'exact-{size}-{method}.tsv',
                  label=f'{size:,} bp, {method}', group='exact means', bench=False)
    reference(f'multibigwigsummary-{size}', 'Track correlation', 'deepTools',
              [MULTIBIGWIGSUMMARY, 'bins', '-b', *TRACKS, '--binSize', size, '-p', THREADS,
               '-o', OUT + '.npz', '--outRawCounts', OUT + '.tab'],
              out=TC / f'deeptools-{size}', made=TC / f'deeptools-{size}.npz', label=f'{size:,} bp, the windows',
              group=group, threads=THREADS)
    for method in METHODS:
        reference(f'plotcorrelation-{size}-{method}', 'Track correlation', 'deepTools',
                  [PLOTCORRELATION, '-in', TC / f'deeptools-{size}.npz', '-c', method, '-p', 'heatmap',
                   '-o', OUT + '.png', '--outFileCorMatrix', OUT + '.tab'],
                  out=TC / f'deeptools-{size}-{method}', made=TC / f'deeptools-{size}-{method}.tab',
                  label=f'{size:,} bp, {method}', group=group)


def square_of(path):
    """A correlation matrix, its tracks put in one order whatever order the file wrote them in."""
    frame = pd.read_csv(path, sep='\t', comment='#', index_col=0)
    frame.index = [str(name).strip("'") for name in frame.index]
    frame.columns = [str(name).strip("'") for name in frame.columns]
    return frame.loc[TRACK_NAMES, TRACK_NAMES].to_numpy(float)


def exact_windows(size):
    """Every track's exact mean over each whole window, by pyBigWig itself: one column a track."""
    def compute():
        handles = [pyBigWig.open(str(path)) for path in TRACKS]
        chroms = handles[0].chroms()
        return np.stack([np.concatenate([np.array(h.stats(c, 0, (n := chroms[c] // size) * size, nBins=n, exact=True),
                                                  dtype=float) for c in chroms if chroms[c] // size > 0])
                         for h in handles], axis=1)
    return cached(TC / f'exact-windows-{size}.npy', compute)


def correlated(columns, method, together=True):
    """Every pair's coefficient: over the windows every track has, or over the pair's own windows."""
    measure = stats.pearsonr if method == 'pearson' else stats.spearmanr
    rows = np.isfinite(columns).all(axis=1) if together else None
    out = []
    for a, b in combinations(range(columns.shape[1]), 2):
        keep = rows if together else np.isfinite(columns[:, a]) & np.isfinite(columns[:, b])
        out.append(measure(columns[keep, a], columns[keep, b])[0])
    return np.array(out)


UPPER = np.triu_indices(len(TRACK_NAMES), 1)
tc_rows, tc = [], {}
for size in SIZES:
    exact_cols = exact_windows(size)
    raw = pd.read_csv(TC / f'deeptools-{size}.tab', sep='\t')
    raw.columns = [str(c).strip("#'") for c in raw.columns]
    deep_cols = raw.loc[(raw['end'] - raw['start']) == size, TRACK_NAMES].to_numpy(float)
    for method in METHODS:
        app = square_of(one(TC / f'app-{size}-{method}', '*.trackcorr.tsv'))[UPPER]
        exact = square_of(TC / f'exact-{size}-{method}.tsv')[UPPER]
        deep = square_of(TC / f'deeptools-{size}-{method}.tab')[UPPER]
        own = correlated(exact_cols, method, together=False)
        tc[size, method] = dict(app=app, exact=exact, deep=deep, own=own)
        tc_rows.append({'windows': f'{size:,} bp', 'method': method, 'pairs': len(app),
                        'left out': f'{(~np.isfinite(exact_cols).all(axis=1)).sum():,} of {len(exact_cols):,}',
                        'chromosomix vs exact, max |Δ|': np.abs(app - exact).max(),
                        'deepTools vs exact, max |Δ|': np.abs(deep - exact).max(),
                        'each pair over its own windows, max |Δ|': np.abs(own - exact).max()})
TC_TABLE = pd.DataFrame(tc_rows)
show(TC_TABLE, **{c: '{:.1e}' for c in TC_TABLE.columns if 'Δ' in c or '…' in c})
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-trackcorr
#| fig-cap: "Three mouse tracks on chr19, correlated. a, Spearman's ρ over 100 bp windows, as chromosomix draws it; b, every coefficient of both methods at all three window sizes against the exact reference — chromosomix in blue, deepTools in orange."
TEXT['tc_n'] = f"{sum(len(v['app']) for v in tc.values())}"
TEXT['tc_app'] = f"{TC_TABLE['chromosomix vs exact, max |Δ|'].max():.1e}"
TEXT['tc_deep'] = f"{TC_TABLE['deepTools vs exact, max |Δ|'].max():.3f}"
TEXT['tc_deep_100'] = f"{TC_TABLE.loc[TC_TABLE['windows'] == '100 bp', 'deepTools vs exact, max |Δ|'].max():.1e}"
TEXT['tc_rule'] = f"{TC_TABLE['each pair over its own windows, max |Δ|'].max():.3f}"
TEXT['tc_left'] = TC_TABLE.loc[TC_TABLE['windows'] == '100 bp', 'left out'].iloc[0]
# The two replicates, Spearman at 100 bp: the pair the rule moves, over every track's windows and
# over their own.
REPLICATES = list(combinations(range(len(TRACK_NAMES)), 2)).index((0, 1))
TEXT['tc_reps'] = f"{tc[100, 'spearman']['exact'][REPLICATES]:.3f}"
TEXT['tc_reps_own'] = f"{tc[100, 'spearman']['own'][REPLICATES]:.3f}"
TC_EXACT = TC_TABLE['chromosomix vs exact, max |Δ|'].max() < 1e-5

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.6), layout='constrained', width_ratios=[1.05, 1])
ax = axes[0]
heat = square_of(one(TC / 'app-100-spearman', '*.trackcorr.tsv'))
image = ax.imshow(heat, cmap='RdBu_r', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
short = [SHORT[name] for name in TRACK_NAMES]
ax.set_xticks(range(len(short)), short, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax.set_yticks(range(len(short)), short)
ax.grid(False)
ax.set_title('a  Spearman ρ, 100 bp windows')
plt.colorbar(image, ax=ax, shrink=0.8, label='ρ')
ax = axes[1]
exact_all = np.concatenate([v['exact'] for v in tc.values()])
ax.scatter(exact_all, np.concatenate([v['deep'] for v in tc.values()]), s=16, color=REF, label='deepTools', zorder=2)
ax.scatter(exact_all, np.concatenate([v['app'] for v in tc.values()]), s=10, color=APP_COLOUR, label='chromosomix', zorder=3)
identity(ax, exact_all.min(), exact_all.max())
ax.set(xlabel='exact window means, pyBigWig and SciPy', ylabel='the tool’s coefficient',
       title='b  every pair, both methods, three window sizes')
ax.legend(loc='upper left')
plt.show()
```

All `{python} TEXT['tc_n']` coefficients from chromosomix agree with the exact reference within
`{python} TEXT['tc_app']`, the six digits it writes, over the same windows: at 100 bp,
`{python} TEXT['tc_left']` windows lack a value in at least one track and are left out of every
pair. deepTools' coefficients differ by up to `{python} TEXT['tc_deep']`, all of it its window means,
read from a zoom level where a file has one fine enough; at 100 bp no file has, and deepTools is
within `{python} TEXT['tc_deep_100']`, the four digits it writes. Had each pair kept its own
windows, as chromosomix once did, a coefficient would have moved by up to `{python} TEXT['tc_rule']`:
the two replicates' ρ at 100 bp would read `{python} TEXT['tc_reps_own']` rather than
`{python} TEXT['tc_reps']`.

```{python}
def manifest():
    """Every command, for timing.qmd: in the summary's order, each analysis's chromosomix commands before
    its references, each with what the timing needs to run it again and to say what it was."""
    data = {row['Analysis']: (row['§'], row['Data']) for row in SUMMARY}
    out = []
    for analysis, (section, about) in data.items():
        for name, app in APP.items():
            if app['analysis'] == analysis:
                out.append(dict(name=name, section=section, analysis=analysis, data=about, tool='chromosomix',
                                version=APP_VERSION, variant=app['label'], group=app['group'], threads=1,
                                bench=app['bench'], argv=app['argv'], out=None, env=None, command=app['shown']))
        for name, ref in REFS.items():
            if ref['analysis'] == analysis:
                out.append(dict(name=name, section=section, analysis=analysis, data=about, tool=ref['tool'],
                                version=TOOL_VERSIONS.get(ref['tool'], '?'), variant=ref['label'], group=ref['group'],
                                threads=ref['threads'], bench=ref['bench'], argv=ref['argv'], out=ref['out'].name,
                                env=ref['env'], command=ref['shown']))
    return {'placeholder': OUT, 'chromosomix': APP_VERSION, 'threads': THREADS, 'commands': out}


MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps(manifest(), indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
listed = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text())['commands']
measures({'commands written for timing.qmd': f"{len(listed)} ({sum(c['bench'] for c in listed)} timed)",
          'to': rel(MANIFEST), 'verdicts to': rel(VERDICTS_TSV)})
```

```{python}
VERDICTS = summary.set_index('Analysis')['Verdict']


def named(analysis):
    """An analysis's name inside a sentence."""
    return analysis if analysis.startswith(('P(s)', 'APA', 'Boost-HiC', '3D')) else analysis[0].lower() + analysis[1:]


EXACT = [a for a, v in VERDICTS.items() if v.startswith('Identical')]
REST = [a for a in VERDICTS.index if a not in EXACT and not a.startswith('3D')]
TEXT['identical'] = '; '.join(map(named, EXACT))
TEXT['n_identical'] = f'{len(EXACT)}'
TEXT['others'] = '; '.join(f'{named(a)}: {VERDICTS[a][0].lower() + VERDICTS[a][1:]}' for a in REST) or 'none'
```

`{python} TEXT['n_identical']` of the `{python} str(len(SUMMARY))` analyses reproduce their reference to
the float32 the app computes in or the digits it writes: `{python} TEXT['identical']`. Where a reference
draws at random — the controls of a pileup, the shuffles of an overlap, IDR's ties — the app's answer
lies within the reference's own spread from one seed to the next. Besides those: `{python} TEXT['others']`.
The 3D model fits the contacts within chromosomes `{python} TEXT['p3_within_word']` pastis, and over
all pairs `{python} TEXT['p3_all_word']` pastis. P(s) as a density (HiContacts' `distanceLaw`), the
app's default, is held to HiContacts by the unit tests (`test/golden/analysis/hicontacts_ps.json`).
Each command's time is measured by `{python} R.link('timing')`.
